name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap is a friendly running race made up of optional laps in the Dióskert area of Törökbálint. The half-marathon distance is covered by completing four laps. Participants may run as many laps as they wish. The suggested entry fee is 500 Ft per lap to help cover the race costs. All participants are welcomed with apples, hot tea and mulled wine, and receive a commemorative medal; the top three men and women also receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, and registration takes place on site.
course_highlights: The course is in the Dióskert area of Törökbálint
The half-marathon distance is covered in 4 laps
Participants may run as many laps as they wish
additional: Registration is on site, with a suggested voluntary entry fee of 500 Ft per lap. All participants receive a commemorative medal, and the top three men and women also receive a special medal. The awards ceremony is at 12:00. After the race, participants are offered hot tea, mulled wine and apples. Four laps make up the half-marathon; participants may run fewer laps. On-site registration; refreshments included.

name: SÍHÁZ KUPA
organizer: Normafa Síház Étterem és Terasz; Sanyoszistálló
description: The 7th Síház Cup is a friendly forest running race at Budapest’s Normafa Síház, taking place for the seventh time this year. Participants can choose individual distances of 5.3 km, 10.6 km, or a half marathon (21.1 km), as well as a 3 × 5.3 km relay. Participants receive an organized course tour, a personalized race bib, refreshments, a finisher’s medal, and chip timing. The race also takes environmental protection into account: water at the aid station is available only in participants’ own cups. The event is held with the support of Sanyoszistálló, and awards are given by distance and gender.
course_highlights: Forest running in the Normafa area
A friendly atmosphere with two-legged and four-legged friends
A flat course with no elevation gain
additional: The entry fee includes an organized course tour, a personalized race bib, refreshments, a finisher’s medal, chip timing, and access to a fully equipped changing room. The number of participants is limited to a maximum of 150. The course is marked with ribbons; leaving the course results in disqualification. Only water will be available at the aid station, and it can be consumed from participants’ own cups. In relay teams, if at least one runner is male, the team is classified as a men’s team. The course is marked with ribbons, and water will be available at the aid stations; participants are advised to bring their own cups. Chip timing and a finisher’s medal are included in registration.

name: SZEGEDI JÓTÉKONYSÁGI FÉLMARATON
description: The Szeged Charity Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in Erzsébet Grove in Szeged. The event offers runners several distances, including a half marathon, 10 km, 6 km and children’s races. Its aim is to promote sport and support children’s futures. Pacers help runners reach their target times, and a sweeper cyclist ensures that the time limit is observed.
course_highlights: The route runs through Erzsébet Grove in Újszeged
Several distances are available, including a half marathon, 10 km, 6 km and children’s races
Pacers help runners finish within various target times
additional: The race has time limits; participants in the main distances must finish by 13:00 at the latest. A sweeper cyclist follows the field, and anyone who finishes behind the cyclist is disqualified. Children aged 2–6 may take part in the children’s races (Hópihe 500 m) accompanied by a parent; parents do not need to register. Several relay options are available: two-person and four-person half marathon relays. Children aged 2–6 may take part in the 500-metre children’s race accompanied by a parent. The finish time limit for the half marathon and longer distances is 13:00.

name: GARMIN WTF CITY
location: Czakó utcai Sport- és Szabadidőközpont, Budapest
description: Garmin WTF CITY is the season-closing run of the WTF race series in Budapest, starting from the Czakó utca sports and leisure centre. The 10 km route runs through the Tabán, over Gellért Hill, across Liberty Bridge and along the Pest riverside before returning to the Citadella viewpoint. It is a bit trail and a bit asphalt, with a relaxed, cheerful vibe where beginners and pros run together, and the shorter distance is 4 km. It is a community run with QR-code timing on open roads where normal traffic rules apply.
course_highlights: 10 km over Gellért Hill, Liberty Bridge and the Danube bank
Mix of trail and asphalt
Jingle & run Santa pack at the finish
additional: Race centre opens 10:00, starts at 11:00, cut-off 13:30. Timing by QR codes, no podium. Ötpróba points: 10 km 2 points, 4 km 1 point. Merchandise is handed out only on site at the finish.

name: Főnix Resort Terepfutás
description: The Főnix Resort trail run is a stage of the Palóc Trail Marathon Cup in Nógrádgárdony, starting from the Főnix Resort hotel. The 5 km course bypasses the village of Iliny and crosses Mária Hill to Lake Tábi, with about 170 metres of climbing. The 10 and 20 km cup races share their first section with the 5 km route. The return route may still change to avoid muddy sections.
course_highlights: 5, 10 and 20 km trail races
Route over Mária Hill to Lake Tábi
Part of the Palóc Trail Marathon Cup
additional: All distances start at 11:00. Village buses help runners get there on Sunday. Pre-registration on sportorigo.com.

name: DEBRECEN MARATON
description: The Debrecen Marathon is a community running event that takes in the landmarks and charming squares of the city of Debrecen. The race welcomes running enthusiasts across five different distances and seven categories, whether they are professionals or amateurs. The event aims to provide an unforgettable experience in a modern, high-quality setting, while runners can enjoy the pleasure of running and the beauty of the city together. The marathon offers both individual and relay distances, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them.
course_highlights: The course passes Debrecen’s most distinctive buildings and squares, as well as Nagyerdei Park
The marathon is run over four laps, the half marathon over two laps, and the quarter marathon over one lap
An internationally certified course that also showcases the city’s charming downtown and university areas
additional: The marathon distance is also available as a relay for teams of 2, 3 or 4, with separate awards. The time limits are 6 hours for the marathon and 3 hours 45 minutes for the half marathon. Race-pack pickup is available on Friday and Saturday, as well as on race day. Refreshment stations and a pasta party will be available to participants. The course is internationally certified, and a “sweeper” vehicle will also help ensure participants’ safety.

name: KIS-DUNA MARATON
location: Szent Imre Katolikus Általános Iskola, Szent István tér 22, Ráckeve, Hungary
description: The Kis-Duna Marathon is a non-profit running race held in the beautiful countryside of Ráckeve, along the banks of the Kis-Duna. The race offers challenges over three distances: 10 km, half marathon and marathon, each following varied routes that are mainly paved and gravel. A special feature of the course is crossing the Tassi lock, which offers participants an exciting experience. The event aims to encourage runners to compete against themselves and enjoy being close to nature in a friendly, welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: The marathon route runs 90% on low-traffic roads in a holiday area
The course is 80% paved, with the remaining 20% consisting of compacted gravel roads and grassy paths
Crossing the Tassi lock via a narrow footbridge, and running along the Danube
additional: The race uses chip timing, with three split timing points (at the start, at 10 km and at 21.1 km). The marathon time limit is 6 hours, and runners must reach the half-marathon split timing point within 2 hours and 50 minutes. Race bibs must be returned after finishing. There is no on-site registration; registration is expected to open on February 1. Medical supervision is provided at the event, and the field is limited, so it is possible to be placed on a waiting list. Race headquarters: the courtyard of Szent Imre Catholic Primary School, Ráckeve, Szent István tér 22.

name: ADVENTI JÓTÉKONY FUTÁS
description: The Advent Charity Run is a welcoming, family-friendly running event in Bölcske, where participants can test their abilities over 3 or 6 kilometers. Part of the entry fee goes to charity, making the event not only a sporting activity but also a chance to help others. It is ideal for both beginners and experienced runners looking to enjoy a pleasant winter running event.
course_highlights: Choose between 3 km and 6 km
A family-friendly running event supporting charity
Set in the natural surroundings of Bölcske
additional: HUF 500 from each entry fee goes to charity. Runners can choose whether to take part in the 3 km or 6 km event. Family registration is also available for the 2 km distance, for up to 4 participants. The event supports charitable causes, payment of the entry fee is mandatory, and participation is open to all ages. The run takes place at 1435/6 Csorda út, Bölcske.

name: ADVENTI KOCOGÓ
description: The Advent Jog is a charity running event held at the Benkó Zoltán Leisure Centre in Kecskemét. The aim is to raise donations for the NM Foundation for the Recovery of Muscles, supporting children with Duchenne muscular dystrophy, including Marci Nemes. The event offers participants a sense of community and an active experience while serving a worthy cause. The organizers thank all the runners and volunteers who contributed to its success.
course_highlights: The run takes place at the Benkó Zoltán Leisure Centre
A charity event supporting children with Duchenne muscular dystrophy
A community-focused sporting experience for families and runners
additional: Volunteers also help behind the scenes at the event. The run is organized for charity, supporting the local foundation and children with the condition. It is part of the Advent season; the run supports the recovery of sick children and is traditionally held every year to bring the community together.

description: The Oxygen Cup is a winter running series in Debrecen’s Great Forest, offering middle- and long-distance runners and amateur athletes the opportunity to compete. The event aims to promote running and a healthy lifestyle, while participants tackle the distances on runner- and joint-friendly surfaces, surrounded by nature. The series traditionally includes multiple age groups and distances, so everyone can find a suitable challenge. The races have a friendly, welcoming atmosphere, and the team competition is also a popular part of the event.
course_highlights: Runner- and joint-friendly surfaces on the trails of Debrecen’s Great Forest
Distances from 1.5 km to 10 km for multiple age groups
A nature-filled forest running route in Debrecen
additional: There is no entry fee for individual races in the series. Teams in the team competition must have a minimum of 4 and a maximum of 8 members, regardless of gender or age. The team competition scoring system is available on sportstopper.hu the day after the race. Parking is available in the lot next to the cemetery. Participants need to register once a year for the series; the chip-enabled race bib costs 2000 HUF.

name: NYÚLCIPŐBOLT BUDAI TRAIL
description: NYÚLCIPŐBOLT BUDAI TRAIL is an exciting trail-running event taking place on December 6, 2026, in Telki, amid the scenic landscapes of the Buda Hills. The race offers nature lovers the chance to run on varied terrain in the fresh air and enjoy the peace and challenges of the hills. The event is organized by Traxpace, and runners can test their strength over various distances while enjoying the beauty of nature. The event is open to all runners. No price category is specified, but the location and date promise a special winter-running experience.
course_highlights: Varied terrain in the Buda Hills
Winter weather conditions and fresh air
Various distances, with a challenge for every runner
additional: Participants can enjoy the beauty of nature, and the event offers a special running experience in the Buda Hills during the winter season.

name: STOP-MIKULÁS FUTÁS
description: The Stop Santa Claus Run is a traditional, family-friendly running race in Tatabánya, held for the 33rd time in 2025. The event features three distances: 200 metres for young children, and 1,900 and 5,900 metres for adults and older runners. More than 200 people took part, each receiving a unique finisher’s medal, and Santa’s gifts await the youngest participants. The race has a welcoming, family atmosphere, with the organisers presenting numerous prizes and special awards. Participants can also celebrate those with December birthdays with cake and pastries.
course_highlights: Three distances: 200 m, 1,900 m and 5,900 m
Unique finisher’s medal for the 1,900 m and 5,900 m distances
Family-friendly atmosphere, with gifts from Santa for the children
additional: Runners over 70 are honoured with certificates, and the sportiest families receive a special award. The event’s main sponsors are Tatabányai SC and Stop Cukrászda, which treats participants to cake and pastries. The oldest participant completed the longest distance at the age of 87. Community support, an awards ceremony, gifts and a cheerful winter running celebration.

name: 9. Tárkányi Hegyifutó Versenysorozat – 1. forduló
description: The 9th Tárkány Hill Running Series is a three-race mountain running event held in Felsőtárkány. Runners can choose from several distances ranging from 2.5 km to 22 km, offering a suitable challenge for every age group and gender. The event is supported by Aktív Magyarország, and participants can register after signing up. The series aims to promote running close to nature and strengthen a sports-friendly community.
course_highlights: Varied mountain running terrain with distances of 2.5 km, 4.6 km, 11 km, and 22 km
Running close to nature in the area around Felsőtárkány
Three-race series
additional: Only logged-in users can order services.

name: V. RUNPUNCH
organizer: Balatonfüredi Atlétikai Club; Balatonfüredi Sport Club; Bakonyország Balcsipart Egyesület
price_range: 8 900–10 900 Ft; a junior futam előnevezéssel ingyenes
description: The V. RUNPUNCH is a family-friendly running event in Balatonfüred, taking place on December 6, 2026. To round off the sports season, the event welcomes participants with a run featuring punch and hot tea. Runners can choose from several distances, including a half marathon, mini marathon, minimarathon, junior marathon, and a special Cliff Young gumboot run. The race takes place on easy-to-run asphalt, promenade, and cycle path sections, with refreshments and prizes.
course_highlights: Easy-to-run asphalt, promenade, and cycle path
Start and finish at the Kisfaludy Gallery; refreshment stations every 5 km with water, isotonic drink, and bananas
875-meter Cliff Young gumboot run, a fun run that closes the event
additional: Separate registration is required for the Junior Marathon so Santa Claus knows which children have been good. There is no separate entry fee for the Cliff Young gumboot run; you can register for it together with another race. The race center is heated, and medical supervision is available on site. Parking at Kisfaludy Beach is free for participants. The race center is located in the Kisfaludy Gallery. Refreshments are available at the start, finish, and every 5 kilometers; runners should use their own bottles. Free parking is available at Kisfaludy Beach.

name: Négy Évszak Futás – Tél
description: The Four Seasons Run – Winter is a traditional winter running race in Komló, held at the KBSK track. The event is organized by the Association of Student and Self-Organized Clubs, which has been offering active sports programs to the local community for years. The race takes place in a friendly, family atmosphere, and every participant receives a unique finisher’s medal. The goal is to promote sport and community life during the winter season as well.
course_highlights: Held at the KBSK track
Running in winter weather conditions
Friendly, community atmosphere
additional: Pre-registration is available using the form on the website and does not constitute a commitment. Participants can also look forward to a raffle and special prizes. The event is supported by Active Hungary. Online registration is available.

name: Futapest Mikulás Futás
description: The Futapest Mikulás Run is a trail-running race in Csömör, organized by the Futapest Club. The race offers runners the chance to enjoy nature and varied terrain, making it an ideal choice for those who enjoy cross-country and mountain running. Traditionally held in early December, the event has a friendly atmosphere and is open to all ages.
course_highlights: Trail running on varied forest and hilly terrain
Takes place in the natural surroundings of Csömör
A course with a cross-country and mountain-running character
additional: The event also includes an awards ceremony and a raffle.

name: KOMÉTA FARSANGI FÉLMARATON
organizer: Kaposvári Szabadidő Egyesület, Attidas Kft., Tiempo Libre Egyesület
description: The KOMÉTA Carnival Half Marathon is held in Kaposvár, traditionally on the Sunday closest to Dorottya Day, to preserve the carnival memories of Mihály Csokonai Vitéz. The event offers several race distances, including a half marathon, a 10 km road race, and family and children’s races. The program also includes city walks showcasing Kaposvár’s landmarks. The course has varied elevation: the half marathon passes over five hills, making it a challenge for participants. Runners can expect professional support at the aid stations, and local treats and drinks are available to sample at the finish.
course_highlights: Half marathon: 21.1 km, 320 m of elevation gain, passing over five hills
10 km: 84 m of elevation gain, including one hill
City walks of 5 km and 15 km showcasing Kaposvár’s sights
additional: The half marathon has a time limit of 3 hours, with a split time limit of 72 minutes at 8.4 km. High5 aid stations are available along the course. At the finish, water, KOMETA and FINO samples, and tea are available. The event center, start, and finish are all at Kossuth Square. The half marathon also offers 2–3-person relays, and there is a two-person relay for the 10 km race. There are no time limits for the family and children’s distances. The latest finish time for the city walks is 14:00. The program also includes 10 km, 5 km, and shorter races, as well as 5 km and 15 km city walks.

name: BORVIDÉK FÉLMARATON
distance_verbose: 23 km, 17 km, 14 km, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: The Borvidék Half Marathon is a running race in Szekszárd offering a range of distances on asphalt and gravel routes. Participants can compete individually or in teams. The longest distance is 23 km and can also be completed as a 2- or 3-person relay. The race starts at Béla király tér, and aid stations provide refreshments regularly every 3.5–4 kilometres. The event is family-friendly, with a children’s race on the programme. Early registrants also receive a technical T-shirt in their race pack.
course_highlights: Almost 100% asphalt route, with a few hundred metres of gravel on the longer distances
Aid stations every 3.5–4 km with water, glucose tablets, isotonic drink and solid food
The 23 km distance can be run individually or as a team of 2–3, with designated relay points
additional: Children up to age 14 can run the 1 km race, which starts at 12:30. On-site registration is available in limited numbers; there is no on-site registration for the children’s race. Registrations submitted by March 10 include a technical T-shirt; later registrants receive a cotton T-shirt. Race-pack size selection is available on the registration interface. The pedestrian street between Béla tér and Garay tér is cobbled and sloping, so take extra care. There is no on-site registration for the race.

description: Tihany Trail is a winter trail-running and Nordic walking race held on the Tihany Peninsula over varied and challenging terrain. The race offers participants a special experience, with icy views of Lake Balaton and the magic of winter nature. The course offers challenges over several distances—5 km, 10 km, and 15 km—with the start and finish near Tihany Benedictine Primary School. The atmosphere is friendly, and the organizers provide refreshment stations. A special technical T-shirt can also be ordered separately from the race pack.
course_highlights: Varied terrain featuring paved, dirt, and rocky trails
The 10 km and 15 km routes include narrow trails and running along the edge of the caldera
Beautiful views of Lake Balaton and the magic of winter nature
additional: The race pack does not include a T-shirt, but a custom technical running shirt can be ordered separately. Refreshments are available at two points on the course and at the race center. On the course, runners can find water, isotonic sports drink, glucose tablets, salty pretzels, and gummy candies. Trail-running shoes are recommended, with traction aids if needed, as the terrain can be particularly demanding in winter. The start and finish are in the upper courtyard of Tihany Benedictine Primary School, where runners can collect their race packs and relax after the race. The race center is at Tihany Benedictine School, on the shore of Belső-tó (Tihany, Csokonai u. 73.). Trail-running shoes are recommended, with traction aids if needed.

name: GÚTAI VÍZKERESZT MARATON, FÉLMARATON
organizer: Maratón klub Kolárovo - Maraton klub Gúta
description: The Gúta Watermill Marathon and Half Marathon is a traditional winter running event organized by Maraton Klub Kolárovo - Maraton Klub Gúta in the main square of Gúta. The race starts in early January with a cannon shot, and participants can compete over the marathon and half-marathon distances. Runners follow a varied, windy but atmospheric route through the streets of the town and surrounding area. The event is popular with local runners and those from nearby, and participation is limited to ensure a high-quality race.
course_highlights: Starts with a cannon shot in the town’s main square (Templom Square, in front of the Town Hall)
Varied route in and around Gúta, in windy conditions
Runners follow the streets of the town and surrounding area, including some sheltered sections
additional: Registration is by bank transfer only; online registration is not available. Race bibs can be collected before the start at the canteen of Corvin Mátyás Elementary School between 07:30 and 09:20. Entry fees can be refunded only until January 2, 2027, less a €4 administration fee. Participation is limited to a maximum of 200 runners across the marathon and half marathon combined. The race starts from the marketplace in the town of Gúta.

name: FUTAPEST TEREPFUTÁS
description: FUTAPEST Trail Running in Nógrád is an exciting trail race on a varied and challenging course around the Nógrád sports field. Runners can enjoy being close to nature and the varied terrain, making it ideal for trail-running enthusiasts. The event has a friendly atmosphere and is open to all ages for a fun, active day.
course_highlights: Varied terrain in the forests around Nógrád
A nature-filled run around the sports field
Challenging climbs and descents
additional: The race center is located at the sports field in Nógrád.

name: BALATONSZÁRSZÓI TÉLAPÓ FUTÁS
description: The Balatonszárszó Santa Run is RUN/TIME Balaton's season-closing running party, where many run dressed as Santa, Krampus, Rudolph or an elf. The race centre is at the main beach in Balatonszárszó, and the course is a fast, flat asphalt route with a few hundred metres of gravel, running long stretches along Lake Balaton. Distances range from the 400 m elf run and the 1500 m party run through 5 and 10 km to the half marathon, which can be run solo or as a relay of 2-3 runners. On the 10 km walk, a pub quiz awaits participants at the Helka brewery.
course_highlights: Flat, fast asphalt course along Lake Balaton
Half marathon solo or as a 2-3 person relay
Festive costume atmosphere
additional: There are 4 refreshment points on the course and none at the finish. The route is marked by marshals, chalk markings, signs and arrows. Residents of Balatonszárszó get a 30% discount on the entry fee.

name: SZERELMES FÜRED
organizer: Balatonfüredi Atlétikai Club, BakonyOrszág & BalcsiPart Egyesület
description: The Schiller Szerelmes Füred running race is a traditional, heartfelt event in Balatonfüred, held for the tenth time in 2026. Participants can enter the half-marathon, which offers runners a special experience amid scenic surroundings. On-site registration is also available, and every registered participant receives a race number. Runners in the adult events must pay a chip deposit fee. If a finisher’s medal is unavailable, it will be sent by post after the race.
course_highlights: Half-marathon distance amid the scenic surroundings of Balatonfüred
On-site registration available at the race center from 07:15
Chip deposit fee applies only to adult running events
additional: The race center opens at 07:15. Half-marathon runners can start between 10:00 and 11:15. Everyone who registers receives a race number. According to the previous race announcement, the race center opens in the morning and on-site registration is available. A chip deposit fee is payable for adult running events.

name: TAJGA TRAIL
description: Tajga Trail is a night trail running race in Márianosztra, offering runners a special experience in the dark. The use of a flashlight is mandatory, and the organizers provide ample refreshments at the aid stations and at the finish. Participants in every distance receive a unique wooden finisher’s medal, and the first three women and men to finish are awarded separately. The race is popular with trail runners for its atmosphere and closeness to nature.
course_highlights: Night trail running with a mandatory flashlight
Ample refreshments at aid stations (water, cola, isotonic drink, salt tablets, dried fruit, pretzels, glucose tablets, olives)
A unique wooden finisher’s medal for every distance, plus separate medals for the first three women and men to finish
additional: Changing rooms, bag storage, and showers are available at the base. The race zone will be checked to ensure participants have a working flashlight. Runners must carry a mobile phone set to loud audio mode and charged to at least 75%. A headlamp or other working flashlight is mandatory and must remain switched on after sunset. Aid stations, finish-line refreshments, changing rooms, bag storage, and showers are also available.

name: FUTAPEST TEREPFUTÁS
location: Vácrátóti Sportcsarnok, Petőfi tér 6, Vácrátót, Hungary
description: The FUTAPEST Trail Run in Vácrátót is an exciting trail-running race held near the Vácrátót Sports Hall. The event offers runners a chance to enjoy nature and varied terrain, making it an ideal choice for both recreational and competitive runners. It is traditionally organized by Futapest Club, which aims to promote cross-country and trail running in Hungary. The race has a friendly, welcoming atmosphere and offers an opportunity to enjoy an active outing in nature.
course_highlights: Varied terrain around the Vácrátót Sports Hall
A running course close to nature
Sections of varying difficulty for trail runners
additional: The start and event center are at the Vácrátót Sports Hall, at Petőfi tér 6.

name: FUTAPEST TEREPFUTÁS
description: FUTAPEST TRAIL RUNNING is an exciting trail running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Virágospuszta, Bér. The race takes place on varied terrain that offers a challenge to every runner, whether beginner or experienced. Bringing together the beauty of nature and the joy of sport, the event welcomes participants in a friendly atmosphere. Organized by the Futapest Club, it has traditionally been popular among trail runners in Hungary.
course_highlights: Varied terrain close to nature in Virágospuszta
Challenging hilly sections
Picturesque surroundings and fresh air

name: IPOLY MARATON
description: The Ipoly Marathon is a special running race set amid the scenic surroundings of Szob and the Ipoly Valley. The course follows the EuroVelo 6 cycle route across varied terrain, with riverside sections and opportunities to enjoy nature. It is an ideal season-opening challenge, with a fast-running route and a marathon atmosphere far from big-city crowds. The area around the buffalo reserve is one of the race’s iconic sections, lending the run a unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: The route follows the Ipoly along quiet cycle paths and embankments
Much of the course follows the EuroVelo 6 route across varied terrain
An iconic section near the buffalo reserve, with a unique atmosphere
additional: Water, isotonic drinks, cola, bananas, apples, biscuits and glucose tablets are available at refreshment stations. The race centre is in Szob, near the Danube, in a peaceful, nature-rich setting. The course has only 10 metres of elevation difference, making it suitable for fast running. There is only 10 metres of elevation difference between the highest and lowest points of the course.

name: BODRI TRAIL Terepfutás
description: Bodri Trail is a trail-running race in Szekszárd, held on the grounds of the Bodri Winery. Runners can choose from four different distances (XS, S, M, L). The course follows trails, marked hiking routes and, to a small extent, public roads, challenging participants on varied terrain. Aid stations offer water, cola, isotonic drink, fruit and biscuits, while hot food is available at the finish. The race is environmentally conscious and cup-free, so participants must bring their own bottle or cup. Chip timing is provided, and every finisher receives a medal.
course_highlights: The course follows trails and marked hiking routes
Aid stations offer water, isotonic drink, fruit and biscuits
Chip timing and a finisher’s medal for everyone who completes the race
additional: Dogs are not allowed to run in the race, and participants may not be accompanied by motor vehicle or bicycle. A bag drop is available at the race centre, but only sealed bags will be accepted. The Bodri Winery’s rooms provide changing and restroom facilities before and after the race. No plastic cups are provided at aid stations, so participants must bring their own cup or bottle. This is a cup-free race: bring your own bottle or cup to the aid stations. Hot food is provided at the finish; dogs are not allowed to compete.

name: FUTAPEST TEREPFUTÁS
description: Futapest Trail Run in Nagytarcsa is an exciting trail-running race held on varied terrain in a natural setting. It offers a challenge for fans of cross-country and mountain running, where participants can enjoy the beauty of nature and varied running routes. The event is traditionally organized by Futapest Club in a friendly, supportive atmosphere. The venue is at 84 Rákóczi Street in Nagytarcsa and is easy to reach.
course_highlights: Varied terrain close to nature
Challenging ascents and descents
Beautiful views of the surrounding landscape
additional: Parking is available at the race venue (see TarcsaParkolas.jpg). Futapest Club organizes several trail-running events; more information can be found among the race announcements and results. The race headquarters are at HEMO, 84 Rákóczi Street. Parking spaces at the venue are limited.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap is a friendly running race where participants can choose how many laps to complete. It takes place in the Dióskert area of Törökbálint. Runners can complete the half-marathon distance in four laps, but fewer laps are also an option. The event has a welcoming atmosphere, with apples, hot tea and mulled wine for participants. Every entrant receives a commemorative medal, while the top three men and women receive a special medal. The awards ceremony is at 12:00, and registration takes place on-site, with a suggested voluntary entry fee.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Dióskert area of Törökbálint
The half-marathon consists of 4 laps, but participants can choose to run fewer
A friendly, community atmosphere, with apples, hot tea and mulled wine
additional: Registration takes place on-site. The suggested voluntary entry fee is 500 Ft per lap. The awards ceremony is at 12:00. Participants can choose to complete fewer laps. Refreshments and commemorative medals are provided, and the race supports the community and local runners.

name: MALACVÁGTA
description: Malacvágta is a pre-New Year’s recreational running race held at Bókay Garden in Budapest. Several age groups can take part, including junior, adult, senior and veteran categories, and there is also a stroller race. Participation is free, and every runner receives a T-shirt, making this a family-friendly event with a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: 6,000-metre distance for the junior, adult, senior and veteran categories
3,000-metre stroller race
The race takes place at Bókay Garden, Budapest
additional: The event features two races: a 6,000 m race for the junior, adult, senior and veteran categories at 12:20, and a 3,000 m stroller race at 13:00. The venue is Bókay Garden; the race times are 11:35 and 13:40. The event is part of the year-end community programmes.

name: ÚJÉVI MALACOS FUTÁS
description: The New Year’s Piglet Run is a cheerful, community-focused running event held in Budapest’s Népliget at the beginning of each year. The aim is to start the new year in good spirits and stay active, while participants enjoy a unique piglet-themed experience. The event is family-friendly and open to all ages for anyone who would like to kick off the year with a pleasant, fun run.
course_highlights: The green surroundings of Budapest’s Népliget
Easy, flat terrain for a pleasant run
A cheerful piglet-themed atmosphere
additional: There is no bag storage.

name: GÚTAI VÍZKERESZT MARATON, FÉLMARATON
organizer: Maratón klub Kolárovo – Maraton klub Gúta
description: The Gúta Winter Marathon and Half Marathon is a traditional winter running race in Slovakia, in the city of Kolárovo. The race takes place in January, and participants start from the city’s main square, with a cannon shot marking the start. Runners follow a varied route through the streets of the city and its surrounding area, and wind and cold weather can also present challenges during the race. The event is organized by Maraton Klub Kolárovo - Maraton Klub Gúta, and entry fees must be paid in advance by bank transfer. Participants must be over 18 for the marathon and over 16 for the half marathon.

name: FUTAPEST TEREPFUTÁS
description: FUTAPEST Trail Running is an exciting trail-running series held on varied and challenging routes across different parts of Hungary, including Etyek. The races take place in natural settings on forested and hilly terrain, making them ideal for people who enjoy nature and running. Organized by Futapest Klub, the events offer a friendly atmosphere and professional organization for all participants. Several distances are available, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them.
course_highlights: Natural surroundings with forested and hilly terrain
Varied routes across different parts of Hungary
Challenging trail-running courses

name: OXIGÉN KUPA
price_range: 3000 Ft szezonregisztráció + 2000 Ft chipes rajtszám; futamonként nincs nevezési díj
description: The Oxygen Cup is a winter running series in Debrecen’s Great Forest, offering middle- and long-distance runners, as well as amateur athletes, the opportunity to compete. The event aims to promote running and a healthy lifestyle, while participants test their strength close to nature on a running- and joint-friendly surface. The series traditionally includes several age groups and distances, so everyone can find a suitable challenge. The races have a friendly, family-like atmosphere, and the team competition is also a popular part of the event.
course_highlights: Run on the natural, runner-friendly trails of Debrecen’s Great Forest
Several distances and age categories, including distances from 1.5 km to 10 km
Team competition in which the results of the runners with the highest scores count
additional: There is no entry fee per race in the series; registration is valid for every race within one season. Teams may have a minimum of 4 and a maximum of 8 members, regardless of gender or age. Parking is available in the car park next to the cemetery. Annual registration is valid for the remaining races of the season. If weather conditions are unfavorable or the course is dangerous, the canceled round will not be rescheduled.

name: TIHANY TRAIL
location: Tihanyi Bencés Iskola, Csokonai utca 73, Tihany, Hungary
description: Tihany Trail is a winter trail-running and Nordic walking race held on varied, challenging terrain in the beautiful surroundings of the Balaton Uplands. The course is especially distinctive because participants run along the rim of the caldera and on a rocky cliff edge, making for an exciting and scenic race. Participants can choose from 5, 10 and 15 km distances, and aid stations provide hydration and energy. This is a real treat for trail runners, attracting running enthusiasts even in winter.
course_highlights: Varied, challenging terrain in the beautiful surroundings of the Balaton Uplands
Running along the rim of the caldera, on a rocky cliff edge and along narrow trails
Aid stations with water, energy drink, glucose tablets and salted pretzels
additional: Race-pack collection takes place from 8:00 to 9:50, followed by a warm-up with Gabi Piros at 9:50. Refreshments are available at two points on the course and at the event centre. There will be no cups at the aid stations, so participants must bring a flask or cup. On the 15 km course, the first aid station is at the Forest School (approximately 6.9 km) and the second is beside the Apáti Church (approximately 10.3 km). <i:am> mineral+ energy drink and cherry-flavoured hypotonic drink are also available on the course. Trail-running shoes are recommended, with anti-slip aids if needed; road-running shoes are not suitable for the terrain. The race starts at 10:30. The event centre is at Tihanyi Bencés Iskola, Tihany, Csokonai u. 73. The organisers recommend trail-running shoes and, if needed, anti-slip aids. Participants must bring their own cup or flask for the aid stations.

name: FUTAPEST TEREPFUTÁS
description: The FUTAPEST Trail Run in Nagytarcsa is an exciting trail race on varied forest and hilly terrain. It offers a great opportunity to exercise for runners who enjoy being close to nature and taking on a challenge. The event is traditionally friendly and family-oriented, and is organized by Futapest Club. The start and finish are in front of the HEMO building at 84 Rákóczi Street.
course_highlights: Varied forest and hilly terrain
A nature-filled run in Nagytarcsa
A challenging trail-running course
additional: Parking is available at the race venue according to the TarcsaParkolas.jpg map. The event is organized by Futapest Club, which specializes in cross-country and trail running. The race center is at the HEMO building at 84 Rákóczi Street; only a limited number of parking spaces are available on site.

name: VIOLIN MARATON
price_range: 5 000 Ft-tól; a 6 éves korig meghirdetett gyermektáv ingyenes, regisztrációhoz kötött
description: The Violin Marathon is a charity running race organized by the Kodály Zoltán School in Kecskemét. The event aims to support the professional development of the school’s vocational secondary students. It also serves as a community event, bringing together local runners and people who wish to support them. The race takes place at the Kodály Zoltán School, which also serves as the event’s hub.
course_highlights: Closed, paved course through the city centre
Violin music is played at several points along the laps
Distances available: 1 km, 5 km, 10.5 km and 21.1 km
additional: The half marathon can also be completed as a relay. Refreshments are available on each lap, along with chip timing, changing rooms and a bag drop; finishers receive a medal. After the race, participants are offered pastries and hot tea.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap running race takes place at Dióskert in Törökbálint. The handicap format allows participants to complete the designated laps at their own pace. The race route is also the course for the Törökbálint New Year's Eve Half Marathon: four laps make up the half-marathon distance.
course_highlights: The course runs through Dióskert in Törökbálint.
The half-marathon distance is completed in four laps.
The lap-based route also allows participants to run a shorter distance.

name: ALMÁDI KUPA
description: The Almádi Cup is a scenic 11 km trail-running race and walking challenge above Balatonalmádi. Starting from the town center, runners and hikers head to the Óvári Lookout, continue along the ridge of Vödör Valley to the Szentkirályszabadja hunting lodge, and then return to town. The course is marked with orange ribbons. At the finish, participants receive a medal and a pin, and can enjoy hot tea and treats. The event is organized by the Veszprém Bridge and Orienteering Sports Association, which aims to promote hiking and orienteering sports.
course_highlights: 11 km trail-running race and walking challenge above Balatonalmádi
Route to the Óvári Lookout and along the ridge of Vödör Valley
Orange ribbon course marking; GPS track available
additional: Trail runners are timed using the SportIdent chip system. Chip rental costs 300 HUF; participants may use their own chip. Hikers can start between 9:00 and 10:00, with a 4-hour time limit. Race T-shirts can be pre-ordered until January 13 for an additional fee, in cotton or technical fabric, with or without a name. Hot tea, sandwiches, and sweet treats will be available at the finish. The awards ceremony will take place at the finish at 12:30. A parallel 11 km walking challenge will also be held.

name: VASI TEREPFUTÓ SOROZAT - Dozmat
description: The Dozmat race in the Vasi Trail Running Series is a friendly, family-oriented trail race offering close contact with nature and varied terrain. The course leads over gentle rolling hills and rough, muddy sections, so everyone can find a challenge. Electronic timing is used, and category winners receive valuable gifts. The organizers place great emphasis on environmental protection and building a friendly sporting community.
course_highlights: Fast-paced gentle rolling hills
Rough Dozmat mud
Varied terrain and a run close to nature
additional: Race times are recorded using the KORIM electronic timing system. Chips are provided free of charge but must be returned after the race. If a chip is lost, compensation of 20,000 Ft is payable. Bib numbers are made of strong, tear-resistant paper; runners are asked to bring them to every race and reuse them. During registration, a finisher’s medal can be ordered for an extra cost of 2,000 Ft; 120 medals are available per race. Parking is on Vadvirág Street, to the left of the football pitch, to avoid disrupting local traffic. The race takes place at the Dozmat football pitch. Chip timing and live results are provided; race photos can be downloaded free of charge.

name: TAJGA TRAIL
description: TAJGA TRAIL is a night trail running race in Márianosztra, offering runners a special experience in the dark. The use of a flashlight is mandatory, and the organizers provide plentiful refreshments for participants. Finishers in every distance receive a unique wooden finisher’s medal, and the top female and male runners are also awarded separately. The race is popular with trail runners for its atmosphere and closeness to nature.
course_highlights: Night trail running with a mandatory flashlight
Plentiful refreshments at aid stations (water, cola, isotonic drink, salt tablets, dried fruit, pretzels, glucose tablets, olives)
A unique wooden finisher’s medal for every distance, plus a separate medal for the first three female and male finishers
additional: Changing rooms, bag storage, and showers are available at the race base. A working flashlight is checked in the start area. Mobile phones must be set to loud mode and charged to at least 75%. Headlamps must remain switched on throughout the race after sunset; a working mobile phone charged to at least 75% is also required. Changing rooms, bag storage, and showers are available at the race base.

name: KOMÉTA FARSANGI FÉLMARATON
organizer: Péter Attila, Kaposvári Szabadidő Egyesület, Attidas Kft. és Tiempo Libre Egyesület
description: The KOMÉTA Carnival Half Marathon takes place in Kaposvár on the Sunday closest to the traditional Dorottya Day, in keeping with the carnival memories of Mihály Csokonai Vitéz. The event offers several distances, including a half marathon, a 10 km run, family and children’s races, as well as city walks. The varied courses cross hilly terrain and pass some of Kaposvár’s beautiful sights. Runners can expect high-quality refreshments and several categories, whether they are competing individually or as part of a relay team.
course_highlights: Half marathon with 320 m of elevation gain, crossing five hills
10 km course with one hill, passing Rómahegy and the Rippl-Rónai Villa
Finish line in downtown Kaposvár, across the new Eszterházy Bridge
additional: The race centre will be on Kossuth Square in Kaposvár and will be open both the day before the race and on race day. The half marathon has a 3-hour time limit, with intermediate cutoffs. Refreshments will be provided using the professional High5 system; at the finish, runners can enjoy KOMETA and FINO samples, as well as tea. Several relay distances are also available, along with 5 km and 15 km city walks. The entry fee does not include a T-shirt.

name: OXIGÉN KUPA
description: The Oxigén Cup is a winter running series held in the Nagyerdő forest in Debrecen, offering racing opportunities for middle- and long-distance runners as well as amateur athletes. The event aims to promote running and a healthy lifestyle, while giving participants the chance to compete on forest trails with surfaces that are gentle on runners and their joints. The series includes both individual and team competitions, with team scoring following the team competition formula. The event is traditionally very popular, and participants include both amateurs and registered athletes.
course_highlights: Forest trails in the Nagyerdő with surfaces that are gentle on runners and their joints
Multi-lap courses ranging from 1.5 km to 10 km for different age groups
A winter race surrounded by nature
additional: There is no entry fee per race in the series. Teams must have a minimum of 4 and a maximum of 8 members, regardless of gender or age. Team members earn points in the 5 km and 10 km events, and the team's result is based on its 4 best scores. Parking is available in the car park next to the cemetery. Entry and registration are valid for the races in the given season; there is no separate entry fee per race.

name: SZERENCSI FARSANGI FUTÁS
description: The Szerencs Carnival Run is a cheerful community running event held in mid-February in the city of Szerencs, around Rákóczi Castle. Participants receive a finisher’s pack containing a hot drink and sweets to help them recover after crossing the finish line. The event aims to bring sport and carnival spirit together in a friendly atmosphere for all ages. Registration is free, and the organizers provide a convenient online payment option.
course_highlights: The run takes place around historic Rákóczi Castle in Szerencs
A finisher’s pack with a hot drink and sweets at the finish
A community-oriented, family-friendly event in mid-February
additional: Registration is free, and the Barion online payment system is currently suspended. The finisher’s pack is intended to aid recovery in cold weather. The organizer is Tetterő Association; contact: Gergely Pokrovenszki (phone: 30/9766-095). Carnival costumes are recommended, and the most creative costumes will receive prizes. Finisher’s packs in previous event announcements contained sweets and a hot drink.

name: SZERELMES FÜRED

organizer: Balatonfüredi Atlétikai Club, BakonyOrszág & BalcsiPart Egyesület
description: The Schiller Szerelmes Füred running race will be held for the 11th time in 2027 in Balatonfüred, at Vitorlás Square and the Kisfaludy Gallery. The race offers runners several distances, from a children’s race to an ultramarathon, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them. Its special atmosphere comes from its Valentine’s Day theme and its pairs’ and individual events. Participants receive refreshments, a finisher’s medal and a single rose. The course requires runners to keep to the right, and medical coverage is provided. A range of services and activities will also be available at the venue.
course_highlights: Distances: 3.57 km, 7.144 km, 14.29 km, 21.43 km, 50.008 km ultramarathon
Runners must keep to the right. The course is narrow; dogs and strollers are not allowed.
Refreshments include fruit, biscuits and isotonic drinks, with hot tea at the finish.
additional: On-site registration and bib collection are available on race day at the specified times. Women receive a single rose as part of the entry fee. A cloakroom and changing room are available at the Kisfaludy Gallery, and there are 8 portable toilets at the race centre. The race concludes with an awards ceremony and prizes for the first-, second- and third-place finishers. Participants can enjoy free photos and a prize wheel. The entry fee includes a finisher’s medal, refreshments, a race pack and medical coverage. Because the course is narrow, dogs and strollers are not allowed on the running route. Adult race events require a 2,000 Ft timing-chip deposit.

name: VASI TEREPFUTÓ SOROZAT - Pinka EXTREM
description: PINKA EXTREME is the third and final race in the 2027 Vasi Trail Running Series, held in Felsőcsatár near the Children’s Holiday Camp. This trail race offers participants an extreme challenge, with steep sections and varied terrain where ropes help runners climb. The event has a friendly, family atmosphere, and the top three finishers in each category receive valuable gifts. The overall winners of the series will also be awarded after the race.
course_highlights: Extreme terrain with steep sections and rope-assisted climbs
Varied terrain around Felsőcsatár, in the Pinka Gorge
Electronic timing using the KORIM system, with live results tracking
additional: Bib and timing chip collection is from 9:30 to 10:50; on-site registration is available. Bibs are made of strong, tear-resistant paper. A finisher’s medal can be ordered during registration for an extra fee of 2,000 Ft; quantities are limited (120 per race). Chips must be returned after the race; losing one incurs compensation of 20,000 Ft. Parking is on an individual basis along the road leading to the Children’s Holiday Camp; please keep the road used by local residents clear. Distances: 400 m children’s race, 2 km Mini-run, approximately 5 km S distance, 10 km M distance, and 20 km L distance. Registration is via korimtiming.hu; participants can enjoy chip timing and free downloadable race photos. A finisher’s medal can also be ordered separately for 2,000 Ft.

name: YOURS TRULY GYULA
location: Gyulai Várfürdő és Aquapalota, Gyula, Hungary

name: BODRI TRAIL Terepfutás
location: Bodri Pincészet és Faluhely-dűlő, Szekszárd, Hungary
description: Bodri Trail is a trail running race in Szekszárd, set in the picturesque surroundings of Bodri Winery and Faluhely-dűlő. The race offers challenges across four different distances (XS, S, M, L), with a total of 650 participants. The course runs along trails, hiking paths and, to a small extent, public roads, testing runners on varied terrain. Water, cola, isotonic drink, fruit and biscuits are available at aid stations, and hot food is served at the finish. The event is eco-friendly and cup-free, so runners must bring their own bottle or cup.
course_highlights: The course follows trails and marked hiking paths
Aid stations offer water, cola, isotonic drink, fruit and biscuits
Hot food for all participants at the finish
additional: The race uses an ankle-mounted chip timing system; the replacement fee for a lost chip is 15,000 HUF. Runners may not run with dogs or be accompanied by motor vehicles or bicycles. Bag storage is available at the race center, but only sealed bags are accepted. Changing rooms and toilets are available at Bodri Winery before and after the race. All finishers receive a finisher's medal. On the XS distance, the overall top three are awarded; on the S, M and L distances, awards go to the overall and age-group top three. The race is cup-free, so runners must bring their own cup or bottle. Bag storage is available; running with a dog or receiving support from a car or bicycle is not permitted. All finishers receive a medal, and hot food is provided at the finish.

name: BÜKKI KILÁTÁSOK TRAIL
description: Bükki Kilátások Trail is a challenging trail-running race in Felsőtárkány, offering nature lovers a choice of varied distances. Competitors are expected to have mountain experience, and aid stations along the course help them complete the race. Strict rules ensure fair competition and protect the natural environment, while unique awards provide additional motivation. Successful finishers on the different distances receive unique race bibs and awards, and special prizes are also awarded to the fastest uphill runners.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain and varied elevation gain
Aid stations along the course
Special awards for the fastest male and female uphill runners on the Hard and FunRun distances
additional: Mandatory equipment checks are conducted at the race; competitors with incomplete equipment are immediately disqualified. Race bibs are unique and personalized. Competitors may receive assistance at aid stations; outside support is prohibited. Hot meals can also be ordered for competitors at the finish. Each distance has mandatory equipment requirements, and competitors are expected to have mountain experience. GPX files for the courses are available to download.

name: FUSS NEKI FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
distance_verbose: Maraton, 31 km, Félmaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 1500 meter, 0.8 km
description: The 11th Fuss Neki Running Festival will take place on March 6, 2027, by the harbor in Balatonlelle, right on the shore of Lake Balaton. The event offers 7 distances and 12 categories for runners of all ages and experience levels, from the youngest participants to seasoned marathoners, including dog-friendly and Nordic walking distances. The race has a friendly, family-oriented festival atmosphere, with a unique finisher’s medal and a choice of technical or premium T-shirt. The race center offers a range of services, including chip timing, aid stations, a digital certificate, and a personalized finish-line video.
course_highlights: Routes that run right along the shore of Lake Balaton for several kilometers
Breathtaking lakeside scenery and panoramic views
A friendly, family-oriented festival atmosphere with a unique finisher’s medal
additional: Race packs can also be collected on Friday between 12:00 and 16:00. The race center offers changing tents, baggage storage, a race-number collection tent, and exhibitor booths. Race-pack collection closes 30 minutes before the start. The event offers chip timing and awards for overall placings. There will also be group warm-ups with music. The half marathon and marathon can be completed as relays; the 1.5-kilometer distance is dog-friendly.

name: III. Kekes Iconic Trail
description: The III. Kékes Iconic Trail is an iconic trail-running race in the area around the Mátraháza Training Camp, offering runners a range of distances. Participants take on routes with brutal elevation gain across some of the Mátra’s most beautiful and challenging terrain. The event is ideal for both beginners and experienced trail runners looking to experience the excitement and challenge of mountain running. The well-organized race offers personalized race bibs, timing, refreshments, and medical support.
course_highlights: Brutal elevation gain on the Mátra’s distinctive terrain
Routes marked with ribbons and signs
Personalized race bib and professional timing
additional: A technical event T-shirt, finisher’s medal, and hot meal are available as optional add-ons when registering. Shower facilities are available after the race. You can cancel or modify your registration through the link in your confirmation email. The race is an ITRA points race; completing the middle and longer distances earns international points. Race headquarters will be at the Mátraháza Training Camp. Places are limited. Services include route marking, timing, refreshments, medical support, and shower facilities. There will be no plastic cups at the aid stations, so you will need to bring your own flask or hydration bladder.

name: KEK RUN
description: The 7th KEK Run awaits you at the Ludovika Campus on March 6, 2027! Choose from 6 individual distances (1.1–15 km), or complete the 10 or 15 km distance in a pair relay! Chip timing, refreshments, a finisher’s pack and a unique medal await you. Run with us and be part of the KEK community! Register now!

images.alt_text: Futók rajtolnak a zöld KEK Run ív alatt a Ludovika Campuson, szurkolók mellettük.
Futó nők csoportja a Ludovika Aréna előtt, versenyre készülve, több zászlóval körülvéve
Futók indulnak a KEK Run versenyen a Ludovika Campuson, zöld kapuval a háttérben

name: PILIS TRAIL 2026
description: Pilis Trail is a traditional trail-running race in the Pilis Mountains, organized by the Pilisi Terepfutók Baráti Köre since 2013. The race offers several distances, from the half marathon to the ultramarathon, and its night runs offer a special experience, with runners exploring the Pilis’s mystical locations by headlamp. Participants can enjoy the beauty and challenges of nature while becoming part of an active, enthusiastic running community. The forests and rocks of the Pilis are not merely the setting—they are the stars of the race.
course_highlights: Run through the forests and among the rocks of the Pilis Mountains
Night running by headlamp through mystical locations
Distances ranging from the half marathon to the ultramarathon
additional: The race may be completed only on foot, either walking or running. No mandatory equipment is required, but a water bottle, cup or hydration pack, suitable clothing, mobile phone, photo ID and cash are recommended. Entries may be transferred during the registration period, but refunds are not available. Photos and videos may be taken at the race, and the organizers reserve the right to change the route or cancel the race in the event of force majeure. The start is at the clubhouse by the Piliscsaba football pitch. Participants can expect online-tracked timing, refreshment and checkpoint stations, a medal and a hot meal.

name: PÉCS -> HARKÁNY FUTÓVERSENY
description: The Pécs–Harkány Running Race is the region’s oldest traditional road race, and will be held for the 43rd time in 2027. The race aims to promote running and provide an opportunity to assess winter training over a distance of 25.6 kilometres. It offers an excellent opportunity for participants in recreational, competitive and corporate sport, and plays an important role in building community. The event attracts runners from across Hungary and beyond its borders, and is also significant for tourism, showcasing the sights of Pécs and Harkány.
course_highlights: Road race with an individual distance of 25.6 km
Relay race with legs of 8.2 km, 9.1 km and 8.3 km
The race runs between Pécs and Harkány, showcasing local sights
additional: The race is traditionally held on the first Sunday in March. Participants can enter the individual and relay categories. The race’s official Facebook group shares ongoing updates and photos taken at the finish. The listed start time is 11:00. According to the 2026 race information, the entry fee included admission to the baths.

name: VÉRTESKOZMA ROCK AND ROLL FUTÁS
description: The 22nd Vérteskozma Rock ’n Roll Half Marathon is a running race held in a beautiful forest setting in Gánt, Fejér County. Participants can choose from distances of 1 km, 5 km, 10 km and 21.1 km, running on a hilly, paved forest road closed to traffic. Runners are welcomed with aid stations and a valuable race pack. Prizes are also awarded to the top male and female finishers in the 21 km, 10 km and 5 km events. The event is part of the Ötpróba program, so participants can earn points by completing it.
course_highlights: Hilly, paved forest road closed to traffic
Aid stations on the 21 km course at 5 km, 10.5 km and 15 km
Strictly protected natural area; only participants wearing a race bib may be on the course
additional: The race pack contains a Vérteskozma Rock ’n Roll T-shirt, a clay medal, Zámoly craft beer at the finish, Kometa chocolate salami and a 10% discount at SPURI Running Shop. Registration is not required for the 1 km fun run. The race is open to online pre-registration only; there is no on-site registration. The race takes place in a strictly protected natural area, so only participants wearing a race bib may be on the course. The event is part of the Ötpróba program, so participants can earn points and receive a discount with a voucher. Online pre-registration is required for the 5 km, 10 km and 21.1 km distances; there is no on-site registration, and places are limited. Registration is not required for the 1 km fun run.

name: XI. Gánt Trail 13 / 25 / 50 /
description: Gánt Trail is a trail running race offering challenges over three distances: 13 km, 25 km, and 50 km. The course runs through the scenic area around Gánt, among former bauxite mines and forests, across varied terrain with significant elevation gains. The event has a friendly atmosphere, limited capacity, professional organization, and a generous race pack. Runners have access to aid stations and medical support, and finishers receive a finisher’s medal. Organizer Alba Triatlon SE aims to offer runners of all levels an enjoyable challenge in nature.
course_highlights: The 13 km distance has approximately 220 meters of elevation gain, with the course heading southeast from the village center.
The 25 km distance consists of two laps, with approximately 460 meters of elevation gain in total, passing through forest and around the bauxite mines.
The 50 km ultra distance consists of two sets of two laps, with approximately 920 meters of elevation gain, across varied terrain through forests and alongside mines.
additional: The race number can be returned for a 2,000 Ft deposit. Runners with dogs have a separate awards ceremony for the 13k and 25k distances. The race pack includes a High5 gel, race number, chip, and meal voucher. The course is marked with ribbons and direction signs. Parking is available on the surrounding streets; runners are asked to observe no-parking signs. Hot food and a finisher’s medal await participants at the finish. The awards ceremony is expected to take place at 12:30. The start and race headquarters are at Béke tér in Gánt; the race starts at 08:00.

description: The Oxigén Cup is a winter running series in Debrecen’s Nagyerdő, offering middle- and long-distance runners as well as amateur athletes the opportunity to compete. The event aims to promote running and a healthy lifestyle, while participants test their strength close to nature on running- and joint-friendly terrain. The series includes several age groups and distances, so everyone can find a suitable challenge. The event is traditionally very popular, and the team competition is also an important part of the program.
course_highlights: Running- and joint-friendly trails in Debrecen’s Nagyerdő
Distances from 1.5 km to 10 km, on multi-lap courses
A winter forest race close to nature
additional: Participants need to register once per year for the series; the race number is valid for all races in that season. Teams must have a minimum of 4 and a maximum of 8 participants, regardless of gender or age. There is no entry fee for individual races; only the annual registration and race-number fee apply. Parking is available in the lot next to the cemetery. Registration for the series is valid for the remaining races of the season. If weather conditions are unfavorable or the course poses a safety risk, the affected race will be canceled, and no rescheduled date will be set.

name: FUTAPEST TEREPFUTÁS
description: FUTAPEST Trail Running is a traditional trail-running series held on varied and exciting forest and hilly terrain at locations across Hungary. The races aim to share the experience of running close to nature, while allowing participants to test their strength over different distances. The events are organized by Futapest Klub, which has supported the promotion of trail running and community building for many years. The races have a friendly atmosphere, are open to all age groups, and offer runners a range of challenges.
course_highlights: Varied forest and hilly terrain
Running close to nature at locations across Hungary
Different distances and difficulty levels
additional: Race locations include Csömör, Várgesztes, Iklad, and other towns close to nature. Futapest Klub provides the competition rules and membership information on its website. Results and race announcements are regularly available on the website. Race headquarters address: Vácrátót, Petőfi tér 6., Sports Hall.

name: ROMA MARATON
description: Run Rome The Marathon is not just a race, but a journey into the heart of Rome, combining sport, emotion, and beauty. The 42.195 km course passes iconic historic sites such as the Colosseum, Piazza Venezia, Circus Maximus, St. Peter’s Basilica, and the Bocca della Verità, offering runners unique panoramas and experiences. One special feature of the marathon is that participants can also complete the distance as a fitwalk, with pacers to support them. The race starts in the Fori Imperiali area and finishes at Circus Maximus, where runners are welcomed across the finish line in a celebratory atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start in the Fori Imperiali area, with the Colosseum in the background
Pass iconic landmarks including Piazza Venezia, the Palatine Hill, Circus Maximus, St. Peter’s Basilica, and the Bocca della Verità
The 42.195 km course offers historic and modern city panoramas
additional: The start takes place in waves: wheelchair athletes and their assistants start at 8:00, followed by five waves from 8:10 to 9:00, according to the different starting positions. The Expo Village is 50 metres from the Circus Maximus metro station, with free entry. VIP packages are also available through the official store after online registration closes. Alongside the marathon, the official website also lists a four-person relay and a 5-kilometre Fun Run.

name: EGED-FUTÁS
description: The Eged Run is a traditional trail-running race in Eger, showcasing the natural beauty of the city and its surroundings. The race aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and offers an opportunity for athletes, orienteers, triathletes, and recreational runners alike. The 13.4 km course combines asphalt and dirt roads and includes significant elevation gain. The start is next to Érsekkert, in front of the Kemény Ferenc Sports Hall, and timing is chip-based. A shorter 6 km circuit race is also available in Érsekkert, consisting of 5 laps.
course_highlights: 13.4 km distance: 4.5 km asphalt and 8.9 km dirt road
Approximately 480 metres of elevation gain to the Eged Hill lookout
6 km Érsekkert circuit: 5 laps on a marked course
additional: Chip timing provided by Tempo Sport. The longer distance is not recommended for children under 14 due to the elevation gain. Race bibs are non-transferable. The race takes place in Érsekkert, with the start in front of the Kemény Ferenc Sports Hall.

name: FUTAPEST TEREPFUTÁS
location: Szigetmonostori Faluház, Árpád utca 15., Szigetmonostor, Hungary
description: FUTAPEST TRAIL RUNNING is a varied trail-running race series offering exciting courses for runners who enjoy being close to nature and taking on a challenge. The races take place at various locations, including Szigetmonostor, Csömör, Várgesztes, and Iklad, with varied terrain and beautiful natural surroundings. The events are organized by Futapest Klub, which has supported the promotion of trail running in Hungary for many years. The races have a friendly atmosphere, are open to all age groups, and combine the experience of being in nature with sporting achievement.
course_highlights: Varied terrain in forested and hilly surroundings
Beautiful natural landscapes and panoramas along the running routes
Different distances and difficulty levels, from beginners to advanced runners
additional: The races are held at several locations, including the towns of Csömör, Várgesztes, Iklad, and Szigetmonostor. Futapest Klub provides the competition rules and membership information, and publishes results on its website. The races are nature-oriented trail-running events in the cross-country running and mountain running categories. In a previous race announcement, the race headquarters was the Szigetmonostor Village Hall, Árpád utca 15. Participants receive a finisher's medal, and winners and age-group podium finishers are awarded prizes.

name: GERECSE TAVASZI TEREPFUTÁS
location: Integrált Közösségi Szolgáltató Tér, Baj, Hungary
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület (TTT-HSE)
description: The GERECSE Spring Trail Run is a varied trail-running race held in the town of Baj, at the Integrated Community Service Center. The race offers several distances, so everyone can find one that suits them, whether short, medium, or long. Runners can test their strength on varied terrain in beautiful natural surroundings while enjoying views of the Gerecse Mountains. The event has a friendly, family-like atmosphere and also offers a separate category for runners with dogs. The race is part of the Hungarian Defence Forces Trail Running Championship, so competitive athletes also take part.
course_highlights: Varied terrain in the Gerecse Mountains
Three distances: 7.5 km, 15 km, and 26 km, with different elevation gains
Dog-friendly 7.5 km run
additional: The race schedule includes several start times for the different distances: the 26 km starts at 10:00, the 15 km at 10:30, the 7.5 km dog-friendly run at 10:40, the 7.5 km at 10:50, and the 3 km at 10:55. The awards ceremony begins at 12:00. Registration takes place online, and completing the entry form is mandatory. The race is part of the Hungarian Defence Forces Trail Running Championship, so military competitors register separately through their sports officers. The elevation gains for the 7.5 km, 15 km, and 26 km distances are 47, 361, and 697 meters, respectively. The program also includes the Hungarian Defence Forces Championship.

name: MÁRIA MARATON
organizer: Mária Út Közhasznú Egyesület, a Mária Rádió és a Váci Reménység Egyesület Természetjáró Szakosztálya közreműködésével
description: The Mária Marathon is a family running event jointly organized in Vác, at the Hétkápolna Shrine, by the Mária Way, Mária Radio, and the Nature Hiking Section of the Váci Reménység Association. Participants can run distances of 1.6, 4, 8, and 12 kilometers, following the Mária Way markers along the historic Danube riverbank. The event also features faith-related programs, Mass, and a presentation of the shrine, offering a spiritual experience alongside the run. Chip timing ensures accurate results, and finishers of every distance receive a medal. The event is open to all ages; children may participate under parental supervision.
course_highlights: The course starts at Hétkápolna and follows the Mária Way markers
It runs along Vác’s historic Danube riverbank
Chip timing and a finisher’s medal for participants completing the 4, 8, and 12 km distances
additional: The start will be at the Hétkápolna Shrine, with runners setting off together depending on the number of participants. The entry fee includes the right to participate, a secured course, a finisher’s medal, chip timing, a personalized race bib, refreshments along the course and at the finish, medical supervision, and race photos. Children under 10 may participate only with parental supervision and consent. Entries may be transferred by email no later than March 25. The course included both unpaved and paved sections; chip-based net timekeeping was used on the longer distances.

name: SPORTRÉGIÓ FÉLMARATON
description: The III. Sportrégió Ada-Alu Half Marathon will be held in Veszprém at Megyeház Square, where runners can take part individually or in relays over 7 km, 14 km, and 21 km distances. The event is family- and pet-friendly, and new this year are Nordic Walking and a dog run. The event aims to create a shared community sports experience while showcasing nature-oriented courses and views of the Bakony and Lake Balaton. The race is open to all ages, with separate categories for people with disabilities and school teams.
course_highlights: Safe, traffic-free courses at Megyeház Square
Nature-oriented routes with views of the Bakony and Lake Balaton
A range of distances: 7 km, 14 km, and 21 km, available individually or as a relay
additional: School competitions with free entry; free participation for disadvantaged people and people with disabilities; on-site registration subject to capacity; start and finish at Megyeház Square; pre-race packet pickup is mandatory and requires an ID card or authorization. The program also included children's races, Nordic Walking, a dog run, and races for people with disabilities.

description: The Szentkirályi Running Race is a family-friendly event featuring several distances, held in the square in front of the sports hall and on the surrounding streets. The race aims to promote running among all age groups, with separate children’s and adults’ categories. On the children’s distances (nursery, kindergarten, lower-primary and upper-primary), on-site registration is available, while chip timing and entry limits apply to the 2.5, 5 and 10 km distances. Every finisher receives a unique medal, and awards are presented by age group across the different distances.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the square in front of the sports hall and on the surrounding streets
Children’s distances: 750 m and 1.5 km; adult distances: 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km
Chip timing on the 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km distances
additional: On-site registration opens at 08:30. Race numbers must be collected no later than 10 minutes before the start. A cloakroom is available, but valuables cannot be stored. The 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km distances have a 250-entry limit; on-site registration for these distances is available only if places remain. On-site registration is available for the children’s races; for the longer distances, only if places remain. Finishers receive a unique medal.

name: IPOLY MARATON
description: The Ipoly Marathon is a special early-spring running race set in the picturesque surroundings of Szob and the Ipoly Valley. The course follows the Ipoly, away from city noise, along bike paths, embankments and riverside sections, through varied terrain close to nature. An iconic part of the race is the area around the buffalo reserve, which gives the run a unique atmosphere. It is an ideal season-opening challenge for those seeking a fast yet nature-focused marathon experience. The race has a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere and takes place in one of the most beautiful river landscapes of the Danube Bend, without crowds.
course_highlights: The route follows the Ipoly along the EuroVelo 6 route, using bike paths and riverside sections
A special section near the buffalo reserve
Minimal elevation change: just 10 metres between the course’s highest and lowest points
additional: Race numbers can be collected in person at the location and time specified in the race information, upon presentation of photo ID. Aid stations offer water, isotonic drink, cola, bananas, apples, biscuits and glucose tablets. There is no on-site registration; registration is only available online. Participants must dispose of waste in the designated bins and proceed with extra care, adapting to the terrain. The race starts at 10:30. The race centre and race-number pickup are at the cultural centre in Szob; there are no showers.
