name: DEBRECEN MARATON 2026
location: Nagyerdei Stadion északi rendezvénytere, Debrecen, Hungary
organizer: MSE Klaszter Közhasznú Nonprofit Kft., Debreceni Egyetem és Debreceni Sportcentrum Közhasznú Nonprofit Kft.
description: The Debrecen Marathon will take place on April 4, 2027. This recreational sporting event offers a varied urban road-running course that passes Debrecen’s landmarks and historic buildings. The event welcomes running enthusiasts—amateurs and professionals alike—across five distances and seven categories. Its aim is to motivate participants and provide an unforgettable experience in a modern, well-appointed setting with a community atmosphere. The start venue is the event space called HALL at Nagyerdei Stadium, and the course takes in some of Debrecen’s most beautiful downtown and woodland areas, with minimal elevation gain.
course_highlights: A single-loop urban road course through Debrecen’s historic and atmospheric streets and squares
Minimal elevation gain; the course is paved throughout
The marathon is four laps, the half marathon is two laps, and the quarter marathon is one lap
additional: Two types of premium running shirts made from recycled materials can be ordered in advance. The marathon consists of four laps of a 10.5 km course, the half marathon is two laps, and the quarter marathon is one lap. The event also aims to educate participants about environmentally conscious thinking. On-site registration is available on March 27–28. Five distances are offered: 1.7 km, 5 km, 10.548 km, 21.097 km, and 42.195 km. The individual courses of 10.548 km and longer are internationally certified. The race center is at HALL Debrecen, in the northern event area of Nagyerdei Stadium.

name: KIS-DUNA MARATON
location: Szent Imre Katolikus Általános Iskola, Ráckeve, Hungary
description: The Kis-Duna Marathon is a non-profit running race held in the beautiful landscapes of Ráckeve and its surroundings. The race offers three distances: 10 km, half marathon, and marathon. Runners follow low-traffic roads through holiday areas along the banks of the Kis-Duna. Most of the course is paved, with a smaller section on compact gravel roads. The marathon offers a special experience with a crossing over the Tass lock. The event aims to let runners enjoy nature and the community atmosphere while competing and testing their individual performance.
course_highlights: 80% of the course is paved road; 20% is compact gravel road and grassy path
The marathon route follows the banks of the Kis-Duna along low-traffic roads through holiday areas
Crossing the Tass lock on a narrow footbridge offers a special experience
additional: Times are recorded using a chip timing system, with three intermediate timing points (at the start, at 10 km, and at 21.1 km). The marathon has a time limit of 6 hours, and runners must reach the half-marathon timing point within 2 hours and 50 minutes. Race bibs must be returned after finishing. There is no on-site registration; participants must register in advance. Medical supervision is provided. Race-pack collection begins at 7:15, and the race starts at 9:30. The event closes at 16:00. Chip timing and refreshment stations are provided; the marathon has a time limit of 6 hours. On-site registration is not planned.

description: The 42nd Telekom Vivicittá is a popular spring running festival in Budapest, taking place on April 10–11 on Margaret Island. The event offers several distances, from a family run to a half marathon, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them. During the race, you can discover Budapest’s most beautiful areas and World Heritage sites on foot, while enjoying the lively atmosphere created by bands and spectators. Participants will receive a unique finisher’s medal and a technical running shirt to make the day memorable.
course_highlights: Run past Budapest’s World Heritage sites
Beautiful views on Margaret Island
Numerous bands and enthusiastic spectators along the course
additional: The event takes place over two days, with several distances to choose from on Saturday and Sunday. Start times vary by distance; the half marathon starts at 9:00 on Sunday. The entry fee includes a unique finisher’s medal and a technical running shirt, which can be pre-ordered. The event venue is Margaret Island, a green park filled with flowers in the heart of Budapest. The half marathon can be completed individually, in pairs, or as a trio. The weekend program also includes 8 km and 15 km city walks, as well as 2.4 km and 940 m races.

name: VTM powered by Salomon GRVL
description: The VTM powered by Salomon GRVL is a fast trail-running race on non-technical, runnable terrain. It has been held since 2007, the beginning of Terepfutás.hu’s history, and has taken place in a variety of weather conditions, from birdsong and snow to ice, rain, and sunshine. This race is an ideal choice for those who want to run a marathon for the first time.
course_highlights: Fast, non-technical terrain
A variety of weather conditions
Runnable terrain, suitable for first-time marathon runners

name: KIKELET FÉLMARATON
description: The Kikelet Half Marathon Baja is a spring road race held in the city of Baja. The race takes place along one of spring’s most beautiful routes, allowing runners to enjoy a unique combination of nature and urban surroundings. The event traditionally attracts running enthusiasts who can test their abilities over an enjoyable yet challenging half-marathon distance.
course_highlights: A scenic spring route through the city of Baja
A road race with varied surroundings
A traditional, popular half-marathon distance
additional: The race venue is Március 15. Promenade, Baja. Registration and further details are available on the Facebook page. Participants are expected on race day from 8:00 a.m. Previous race announcements listed aid stations every 4–4.5 kilometers and a finisher’s medal for everyone who completes the race.

name: PILIS TRAIL 2026
description: Pilis Trail is a traditional trail running race in the Pilis Mountains, organized by the Pilisi Terepfutók Baráti Köre since 2013. The race offers a variety of distances, from half-marathon to ultramarathon, as well as night runs that put the forests and rocks of the Pilis in the spotlight. Runners become part of a friendly community while enjoying the beauty and challenges of nature. Pilis Trail offers a special experience for both beginners and experienced trail runners.
course_highlights: Run through the forests and over the rocks of the Pilis Mountains
Night running with a headlamp in atmospheric locations
A variety of distances, from half-marathon to ultramarathon
additional: There is no mandatory equipment for the race, but a flask or hydration bladder, appropriate clothing, a switched-on mobile phone, photo ID, and cash are recommended. Runners must pass through every checkpoint; missing one means their result will not be evaluated. Entry is possible only through advance registration, and entry fees can be refunded only during the registration period. The course may be changed or canceled in the event of bad weather or other hazards. The courses have elevation gains of 425 m, 798 m, and 1,734 m, respectively. Participants can expect aid stations and checkpoints, online race tracking, a medal, and a hot meal.

name: III. ÁGOTA® Futás – Fuss Értük Szegeden! Jótékonysági futóverseny
organizer: Csongrád-Csanád Vármegyei Kormányhivatal, Szegedi Tudományegyetem, Gál Ferenс Egyetem
description: The ÁGOTA® Run is a charity running race in Szeged that supports young people in child protection care. The race starts at Dóm Square and follows paved city streets closed to traffic. Participants can choose from several distances, from children’s races to a half marathon, for a day centered on exercise, community, and care. Funds raised from entry fees provide resources for development and experiences for the young people supported.

name: PÓLUS-BUDAPEST MEZEI BAJNOKSÁGA
description: The Pólus-Budapest Cross Country Championships is a traditional outdoor running event organized by the Budapest Athletics Association near the Pólus Center. The race takes place on characteristic cross-country terrain, offering participants a varied and challenging route. The event aims to promote running and support competitive sports in Budapest. It is open to all age groups and offers participants a friendly, family-like atmosphere.
course_highlights: Varied cross-country terrain near the Pólus Center
A challenging course in a natural setting
Close to Budapest’s urban environment
additional: The event takes place near the Pólus Center, Curia utca, Budapest. It is part of the Budapest Athletics Association’s annual competition program. Online payment is available for registration. The event usually runs from 11:00 to 15:00.

name: Vértés Terep Maraton

description: The Vértes Trail Marathon is a challenging trail running race along the scenic trails and forest roads of the Vértes Mountains. The race offers runners several distances, from the ultramarathon to the minimarathon, each with varied elevation and a well-marked course. Participants can enjoy the natural surroundings and a sporting experience, with aid stations, personalized bib numbers, timing, and a generous selection of food at the finish. The event has a friendly, intimate atmosphere, and the organizers pay particular attention to runners’ comfort and safety.

name: Clear'97 Alpokalja Business Run
description: The Clear'97 Alpokalja Business Run is a community-building spring running festival in Szombathely, offering various distances in individual and relay categories for corporate, friendship, and school teams. The race starts with a 2.5 km children’s run, followed by 5 km, 10 km, and 20 km distances, with relay options. The event aims to promote sport and physical activity, with a unique finisher’s medal, electronic timing, and live results tracking. A health day is also part of the event, with mental health professionals and therapy demonstrations for participants. Free parking is available at the Vasi Skanzen car park.

name: Tündér Hegyi Terepfutó Verseny
description: The Tündér Hill Trail Running Race is a varied trail race in the forests between Vilonya and Pétfürdő, on Tündér Hill and in the forests and fields of the Péti Hills. The race offers several distances, including a half marathon, 12.5 km and 7 km, as well as children’s race categories. The courses are marked with orange ribbons, and refreshments are provided on the half-marathon distance. The race uses SportIdent electronic timing. Every participant receives a unique commemorative medal, and the winners of each category receive prizes.
course_highlights: Trail-running route through the forests between Vilonya and Pétfürdő, around Tündér Hill and the Péti Hills
Courses marked with orange ribbons
Refreshments on the half-marathon distance at 10.5 km, at the Pétfürdő forest rest area
additional: Timing is provided by the SportIdent electronic system. Participants may use their own chip or rent one on site for 300 Ft/person. Hot tea, soup and a carnival surprise await runners at the finish. Every participant in the children’s race receives a small gift. A previous race announcement also specified SportIdent electronic timing. A refreshment station was listed on the half-marathon course at 10.5 km.

name: Négy Évszak Futás – Tavasz
description: The spring round of the Four Seasons Run, a Komló-based running series for participants of various ages. Participants can choose from several distances; previous editions have included 2 km and 5.2 km. The event is organized by DÖKE, and the KBSK running track has previously hosted the spring race.
course_highlights: Several distances, including 2 km and 5.2 km in previous editions
Located in Komló; previous spring rounds took place at the KBSK running track
The spring event in the Four Seasons Run series
additional: Runners from several generations have taken part in previous spring editions; 228 participants started in 2026.

name: Fuss a struccal 4 / 7 / 14 / 21
description: The Run with the Ostrich charity running festival takes place at Aranypart in Győr, with runners welcome to take part in several distances: 4, 7, 14 and 21 kilometres. The event supports paediatric care, particularly the purchase of a specialised EEG device to diagnose children with epilepsy and serious conditions. Families, children and four-legged companions can join the festival, while spectators cheer on the participants at the venue. The programme is also supported by well-known athletes and local ambassadors, making it a truly community-minded charity event.
course_highlights: Spectators cheer on runners from the hillside at Aranypart
Choose from several distances: 4, 7, 14 and 21 km
A family-friendly event where four-legged companions can take part
additional: Proceeds from registration fees will be used to purchase paediatric intensive care equipment, particularly a specialised EEG device to diagnose children with epilepsy. The event will also be attended by the Audi ETO KC team doctors, as well as police officers and volunteer firefighters, who will run in their operational uniforms and put on a demonstration.

name: XXIII. Motherson Szigetköz Félmaraton 2 / 5 / 10 / 21
description: The Motherson Szigetköz Half Marathon is a traditional running event in Mosonmagyaróvár, offering several distances for runners, including 2, 5, 10, and 21 kilometers. The race takes place amid the natural beauty of Szigetköz, on varied routes suitable for all ages. Organized by Mosonmagyaróvári Strucc Futóklub SE, it attracts many runners from the region and beyond every year. This friendly, family-oriented event is eagerly anticipated by runners and the local community alike.
course_highlights: Varied routes in the natural surroundings of Szigetköz
Distances: 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon (21 km)
Central location in Mosonmagyaróvár and its surroundings
additional: The race offers several distances, including 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and the half marathon (21 km). The venue is 26 Bokréta Street, Mosonmagyaróvár. Registration usually opens in the first week of January. The organizer is Mosonmagyaróvári Strucc Futóklub SE. The website also provides maps and routes for participants.

name: ULTRABALATON
distance_verbose: 221 km, 41 km, 27 km, 20 km, 13 km, 9 km
organizer: Balatonman Triatlon Kft & FULLCON IT Development Kft
description: In 2026, Ultrabalaton will be held for the 20th time. It is Hungary’s most popular community sporting event. The race is a single-loop running event around Lake Balaton, the longest running race in Central Europe, and can be completed individually or in a team, running or cycling. The 209-kilometer distance is open to individual entrants and teams of 2–6 people. The event has a friendly, community-focused atmosphere and offers appealing activities for supporters and cyclists as well as runners.

name: Mozdulj Csepel!
location: Kolonics György Szabadidőközpont, Hollandi út 8-10, Csepel, Budapest, Hungary
description: Mozdulj, Csepel! is a free family running event in Budapest’s Csepel district, starting from the Kolonics György Leisure Centre. The event offers four distances: 3.5 km, 7 km, a 400-metre children’s race, and a special race for people with disabilities. Runners follow the Kolonics Promenade along the Danube, with chip timing. At the finish, they receive a gym bag, an apple, and cereal. The event is cup-free, so participants must bring their own bottle or cup for refreshments. The event aims to build community and share the joy of exercise with people of all ages.
course_highlights: The start and finish are at the Kolonics György Leisure Centre
Most of the races follow the Kolonics Promenade along the Danube
A special fun run for people with disabilities
additional: Registration is free but required; on-site registration may be available subject to places remaining. The children’s race is not timed and has no podium; it is a fun run. The youngest participants receive a finisher’s medal, while older participants receive a gym bag, an apple, and cereal at the finish.

name: Galbicska Péter Emlékfutás Tata 7 / 14
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: The 6th Péter Galbicska Memorial Run takes place on Lakeside Promenade in Tata. Runners can choose between two distances: 7 km (1 lap around the lake) and 14 km (2 laps around the lake). Entries are accepted by age group and gender. The event has a friendly atmosphere and takes place in lakeside surroundings, offering participants both a challenge and an enjoyable experience. The race starts at 10:00, and registration is open until April 23 at 18:00.

name: BACKYARD ULTRA ESZTERGOM
description: Backyard Ultra Esztergom 2026 is a special ultrarunning race that continues until the last person standing. Competitors complete a 6,706-meter loop every hour, and only those who finish before the next start remain in the race. The event is part of the Hungarian Backyard League and is held as an age-group championship, with the top female and male runners awarded prizes in 11 age groups. The race takes place at Franka Pálya - Gimnázium Sportpálya in Esztergom, and participants who complete distances of up to 160 kilometers may also receive recognition.

name: IX. Miklósi Futónap
description: The 9th Miklósi Running Day is a family-friendly running race held in Szigetszentmiklós. The event offers several race distances, from 500 meters up to the half marathon (21 km). The race starts in front of the City Sports Hall, follows Szebeni Road, Petőfi Road and Gerincút, and then returns to the sports hall. Changing rooms, a cloakroom and toilets are available for runners at the venue. The event aims to promote sport and community for all age groups.

name: III. Strázsa-hegyi Trail Futóverseny 2 / 5 / 10 / 21
description: The 3rd Strázsa-hegy Toyota Kovács Trail Run will take place in Monor, in the Strázsahegy vineyards. Participants can choose from a 500-meter family run, as well as 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and half-marathon distances. Runners can complete the courses on varied terrain in a nature-rich setting. The event aims to promote a love of sport and nature in a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: ÍROTTKŐ HILLCLIMB
description: The Írottkő Hillclimb is a varied and memorable mountain running race held around Rőtfalva in Kőszeg. The race has a new starting location and begins in Bozsok, offering runners a challenge across several distances, from the 7 km introductory trail run to the 102 km Alpokalja Ultra. The courses traverse varied terrain and offer beautiful views and aid stations. Participants will need stamina and good physical fitness. The race also offers family-friendly activities, so even the youngest visitors can enjoy the nature conservation and interactive exhibitions.

name: FUTAPEST TEREPFUTÁS
description: FUTAPEST Trail Run is an exciting trail-running race in the scenic surroundings of Virágospuszta, Bér. The race takes place on varied terrain that challenges every runner, whether beginner or experienced. The event aims to share the joy of running close to nature and build a community among trail runners. It is organized by Futapest Club, which has supported cross-country and trail running in Hungary for many years.
course_highlights: Varied, nature-rich terrain in Virágospuszta
Challenging hilly sections
Scenic surroundings and forest trails

name: XI. Ezerjó Félmaraton 5 / 10 / 21
description: The 11th Ezerjó Half Marathon takes place in Mór, at Szent István Square. The race offers three distances: 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21 km). Runners can tackle the courses through beautiful vineyards on varied terrain, with climbs and panoramic views. The event is family-friendly and also welcomes younger participants with children’s races. At the finish, participants are rewarded with refreshments and a finisher’s medal. The local wine region and the sense of community give the race its distinctive atmosphere.

name: MÉRŐMARATON FUTÓVERSENY
description: The MérőMaraton running race welcomes running and outdoor recreation enthusiasts to the Kaposmérő leisure park. The event offers a sporty community experience, with time spent outdoors taking center stage alongside the competition.
additional: Water, soft drinks, coffee, sales, and a cloakroom are available at the venue; dining is available at the neighboring restaurant.

name: FUT AZ ÜLLŐ
description: “Fut az Üllő” is a traditional city running race held in the center of Üllő. The race aims to promote sport and community life and is open to all age groups. On-site registration is also available in limited numbers on race day from 7 a.m. The race is organized by the Municipality of Üllő, which ensures the event’s success with the support of the local community.

name: II. Mohácsi Gőcze Trail
description: The 2nd Mohácsi Gőcze Trail is a recreational running race held at the Szőlőhegyi event venue in Mohács. The race takes place on the trails of the Mohács Hills and offers various distances for all age groups, from a 500-meter children’s race to a 22 km distance. The family-friendly event provides medical coverage and awards, and participants can have their times recorded using chip timing. Runners can take part in a group warm-up before the start. Participation is at the runners’ own risk.

name: ETYEKRUN (1.)
distance_verbose: Félmaraton, 12 km, 10 km, 7 km, 5.5 km, 5 km, 0.2 km

name: Etyekrun
description: EtyekRUN is a unique running race on the hills of Etyek, where the atmosphere of the wine region and the spring landscape, vineyards, and rows of grapevines accompany participants. The race takes place on May 1 and offers a unique experience for lovers of nature and running. The event has a friendly, family-like atmosphere and provides an inspiring setting for runners.
course_highlights: The hills of Etyek and the atmosphere of the wine region
A route winding among vineyards and rows of grapevines
Spring scenery and a run close to nature

name: 24. Öntúlszárnyalás maraton
distance_verbose: Maraton, Félmaraton, 10.55 km, 10.4 km, 5.27 km, 5.2 km
description: The 24th Self-Transcendence Marathon takes place at Malomvölgyi Lake in Pécs. Organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, this friendly, loop-course running event offers marathon and half-marathon distances. The course runs along forest paths of compacted earth and crushed stone, with 30 metres of elevation gain, giving participants varied terrain to test themselves on. Chip timing ensures accurate results, and the aid stations provide plenty of refreshments.

name: Farkasmályi Dűlő és Pince futás
organizer: Gyöngyösi Triatlon Klub, Farkasmályi Borpincék Egyesület
description: The Farkasmály Vineyard and Cellar Run is an atmospheric trail-running event along the vineyard rows of Farkasmály in Gyöngyös, taking place among vineyards and wine cellars. The event offers challenges over several distances, including a shorter, less hilly 3 km loop and a longer 8.5 km loop with several climbs. Runners can enjoy being close to nature, visits to wine cellars, and varied terrain suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The event is organized by GYÖTRI Klub, which has decades of experience in organizing sporting events.

name: MÁSODSZOR IS CÉLBA ÉRÜNK!
description: Koraszülöttfutás 2026 is a charity running event that starts in Zalaegerszeg and finishes in Keszthely, covering a total distance of 66 km. Along the way, participants pass through beautiful Zala landscapes, with ten relay points, and chip timing tracks the entire distance. The event particularly supports premature babies, who also take part in a dedicated run. At the finish, teams can arrive together to share the experience and celebrate their achievement. The start and pasta party take place at the Zala Zone Automotive Test Track. The event is held on Sunday, May 3.

name: 2. E.ON Business Run
description: The E.ON Business Run is a special running event held at the National Athletics Centre in Budapest. The event aims to bring together people from the corporate world and everyone else who’s interested for a shared experience of exercise, where individual effort and team spirit both shine. Runners can choose from three options: a 5 km individual run, a 3-person relay (3 × 2.7 km), or a 2 km walking tour of the stadium. Music, a party atmosphere and street food accompany the event, making it an unforgettable experience for participants even after the run.

name: Columbia Sunset Trail
description: The Columbia Sunset Trail is an exciting trail-running race held at sunset in the area around Naszály Mountain. Participants receive a unique wooden finisher’s medal, and the top three women and men in each distance receive special prizes. The event offers plenty of aid stations, changing rooms, and bag storage. Runners are advised to use a headlamp and a hydration pack. The atmosphere and proximity to nature are sure to make for an unforgettable experience.

name: COLUMBIA SUNSET TRAIL
description: The Columbia Sunset Trail is an exciting trail-running race held at sunset in the scenic surroundings of Naszály. Every participant receives a unique wooden finisher’s medal, and the top finishers receive special medals. The event offers plenty of refreshment stations, changing rooms, and baggage storage. For a safe race, runners are advised to use a headlamp and a hydration pack. The atmosphere and closeness to nature are sure to make this an unforgettable experience.

name: Krones Charity Run
location: Krones Hungary, Hermann utca 1, Déli Ipari Park, Debrecen, Hungary

description: The Krones Charity Run is a charity race taking place on May 15, 2027, in the Southern Industrial Park in Debrecen. The race aims to promote sport and physical activity and showcase the venue, where Krones Hungary was the first company to move in. All entry fees will be donated to a foundation selected by public vote, with Krones Hungary doubling the donation. Participants can choose from several distances, and every runner who finishes within the time limit will receive a unique finisher’s medal. After the race, participants are welcome at the Athletes Garden.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the Southern Industrial Park, combining an industrial setting with green surroundings
10 km individual race over 4 laps
Full BioTechUSA refreshments are provided at the refreshment stations
additional: The race pack includes a Mizuno event T-shirt for premium entries. The entry fees will go to a foundation chosen by the public, and Krones Hungary will double the donation. The race venue is the Southern Industrial Park, offering a combination of industrial and green surroundings.

name: SCHRÖDINGER DELUXE ULTRA
description: The race starts at Csemetekert at 8:00 a.m. Runners will cover varied terrain, passing several notable sites and natural landmarks in the Pilis Mountains. The race offers a unique experience for lovers of nature and challenge.

name: FARKASMÁLYI DŰLŐ- ÉS PINCEFUTÁS
description: The Farkasmály Vineyard and Cellar Run is a special running event held along the Farkasmály cellar row in Gyöngyös, offering participants a unique experience amid the enchanting natural surroundings of the local wine region. The event is organized by GYÖTRI Club, which has supported sports in the region since 1991. During the run, participants can discover the beauty of the Mátra area and local wineries while exercising and unwinding. The event aims to establish a tradition and welcomes running enthusiasts every year.
course_highlights: The picturesque surroundings of the Farkasmály cellar row in Gyöngyös
A nature-filled running course at the foot of the Mátra
The route passes through the local wine region and by its cellars

name: SzalamandRUN futónap 3 / 5 / 11 / 21 / 42
distance_verbose: Maraton, Félmaraton, 11.4 km, 5 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The SzalamandRUN running day is a race in Solymár offering a variety of distances: 3, 5, 11, 21, and 42 km. The event is ideal for both beginners and experienced runners looking to test themselves over different distances. Set in a natural environment, the race offers participants an enjoyable running experience. The organizers provide professional timing and convenient registration options.

name: Előzd meg a Fogaskerekűt!
description: Beat the Cogwheel Railway! is a traditional sporting event in Budapest’s 12th District. Its aim is for participants to reach the finish before the Cogwheel Railway. The race features an approximately 4 km uphill course with 325 metres of elevation gain, presenting a serious challenge even for well-trained participants. In addition to running and cycling, participants can enter as a relay team with family or colleagues, or hike through the scenic Buda Hills. The event is organised by Hegyvidéki Szabadidősport Nonprofit Kft. and Városmajori Tanuszoda.
course_highlights: Approximately 4 km with 325 m of elevation gain
Uphill course in the Buda Hills
Running, cycling and relay categories
additional: Rules apply to wearing race bibs and using timing chips. The event venue is Hegyvidéki Sportközpont és Tanuszoda, Budapest, Városmajor u. 29. The organisers ask entrants to carefully review the downloadable race information and data protection notice.

name: CSALÁDI FUTÓNAP
location: Bocskai István Általános Iskola, Páty, Hungary
description: The FAMILY RUNNING DAY is a family-friendly running event held at Bocskai István Primary School in Páty. The event aims to provide enjoyable opportunities for people of all ages to exercise together. It is not a competitive race; instead, it focuses on spending time together and enjoying physical activity. Participants can enjoy sports in pleasant surroundings on a safe course.
course_highlights: A safe, family-friendly running course in the centre of Páty
A community running event, not a competition
An easily accessible venue near the primary school

name: EDURACE
distance_verbose: Félmaraton, 10.5 km, 5.3 km, 3000 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km

price_tiers.distance: Csapatfutam (4x2 km) és Kutyás futam (2 km)

description: EDURACE is a family trail-running day in Erzsébet Park in Gödöllő, offering a variety of distances for all ages and types of runners. The race aims to bring the joy of exercise to as many families as possible, with active programs and expert support helping participants along the way. Alongside the running, athletes can enjoy a sense of community and take on challenges, whether they are beginners or experienced runners. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, and companions can also register in advance for a discounted meal.
course_highlights: Trail-running routes in Erzsébet Park, Gödöllő
A variety of distances from 2 km to a half marathon, with separate children’s races
Elevation gains from 24 m to 340 m on varied terrain
additional: Companions can register in advance and order a discounted meal. Coaches, physiotherapists, and massage therapists help participants exercise safely and avoid injuries. Active programs await participants after the race. Child-friendly, short, safe courses are also available for the youngest runners. Photos and results are available after each event.

name: FUT A VÁROS
description: The Szombathely Running Race, Fut a város, is a friendly, community-building event offering a range of distances, from a 400 m children’s race to individual and relay races for adults over 10 km. The race takes place in the heart of the city, in Main Square, and aims to promote sport and a healthy lifestyle for all ages. Chip timing and a finisher’s medal are provided, along with refreshments at the finish. A group warm-up and family-friendly activities make the event special.
course_highlights: A variety of distances: 400 m children’s race, 2 km, 5 km, 10 km individual race, and 4×2.5 km relay
The race takes place in central Szombathely, in Main Square
Chip timing and a finisher’s medal for everyone who finishes
additional: Registration and race-pack pickup begin at 7:30 at the event venue. Limited on-site registration is available, with card payment. The use of mobile phones and audio devices with headphones during the race is prohibited. For competitors under 14, parental consent is required for distances over 2 km. Medical supervision and partially closed routes are provided during the race.

name: ÚJPESTI FÉLMARATON
location: Halassy Olivér Sportközpont, Budapest IV. kerület, Hungary
description: The Újpest Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in Budapest’s District IV, around the Halassy Olivér Sports Center. Competitors can test their strength over the half-marathon distance in a pleasant urban setting. The event has a friendly, community-oriented atmosphere, and registration is paid for by bank transfer. The race is supported by the local municipality, which helps ensure smooth event operations.
course_highlights: Run around the Halassy Olivér Sports Center
Urban setting with a clearly marked course
Friendly, community-oriented atmosphere
additional: The entry fee can be paid only by bank transfer, within 3 business days after registration. Participants are asked to include their tax identification number in the payment reference, or the team name for relay entries.

name: Garmin WTF BRZSNY
distance_verbose: 43 km, Maraton, 33 km, 23 km, 13 km, 10 km, 8 km
organizer: RUNaway Rekreációs Kft. és RUNaway Sportszervező Kft.
description: The Garmin WTF BRZSNY is a unique trail-running race held around Szokolya and Királyrét. It offers challenges over several distances, from 8 km up to a 42 km trail marathon, with varied elevation and beautiful forest scenery. A special feature of the race is that road and trail runners start together, so everyone can complete the distance on their preferred terrain. The entry fee includes a race bib, timing, aid stations, bag storage, changing facilities and emergency medical services, as well as chimney cake at the finish and optional medals. The race puts sustainability and community spirit first, where every achievement matters.

name: IX. Runbogárd Futóverseny és családi futónap
description: The 9th Runbogárd Running Race and Family Running Day will be held in Sárbogárd, at the City Sports Hall. Runners can choose from the 1 km Smile Run and the 5 km, 10 km, and 20 km distances. All participants start together in a mass start. The event aims to promote the love of sport and create a community gathering where people of all ages can find a distance that suits them. Race numbers must be collected in advance; on-site registration is not available. Timing is chip-based, with the chip attached to the back of the race number.

name: Fertőrákos félmaraton 6 / 16 / 21
description: The Fertőrákos Half Marathon is a unique scenic run above Lake Fertő, starting and finishing at the Quarry – Cave Theatre. The varied, gently undulating course takes in some of the area’s most beautiful spots. The longer distance reaches as far as Balf, with runners accompanied by views of picturesque Lake Fertő and its reed beds. This race is not just a challenge but an enjoyable running experience, with new sights and inspiration at every kilometre. The event is also run as a green race, highlighting the importance of environmental protection.

name: EU-S FUTÁS 2026
organizer: Európai Bizottság Magyarországi Képviselete, Európai Parlament Magyarországi Kapcsolattartó Iroda, Nagy Sportágválasztó, BBU Nonprofit Kft.
description: The EU Half Marathon is a free running race that requires registration and is held at Szabadság Square in Budapest. Participants can complete the 21.1-kilometre distance individually or as part of a 2–3-person relay. The race is part of Budapest’s Europe Day festival. Runners follow a three-lap route passing through iconic locations in Budapest, and every finisher receives a unique commemorative medal. The event is organized by the Representation of the European Commission in Hungary and the European Parliament Liaison Office in Hungary, with Nagy Sportágválasztó, BBU Nonprofit Ltd. as its professional partner.

name: FUSSUK LE! FÉLMARATON FESZTIVÁL
description: The Fussuk le! Half Marathon Festival is a three-day running event held in Csongrád. Participants can enjoy concerts, community activities and races, including half-marathon and quarter-marathon distances, as well as children’s races. The course is flat and paved, making it ideal for runners of all levels who want to race in a fun, supportive community. The event aims to provide an unforgettable experience where runners can smile their way to the finish.

name: UBM RED RUN FUTÓVERSENY
description: The UBM RedRun takes place in the heart of Pilisvörösvár, around Kacsa Lake. The event welcomes runners for its fifth anniversary, with distances ranging from 300 metres to 21 km, available individually or as part of a team. Featuring new courses, extended distances, and unique races, it offers an experience for all ages, with a particular focus on families and amateur athletes. The event aims to create a shared sporting experience in a safe and friendly setting, through some of the most beautiful parts of Pilisvörösvár.

name: FUTAPEST TEREPFUTÁS
description: FUTAPEST TRAIL RUNNING is a varied trail running series held at the sports field in Nógrád. The races take place over different distances on varied terrain, through forests and hilly surroundings. The event aims to promote running close to nature and create a sense of community for runners. Organized by Futapest Klub, the events offer a friendly atmosphere and a challenge for all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Varied terrain, including forest and hilly sections
Running close to nature around Nógrád
Different distances for every runner
additional: The races are organized by Futapest Klub, which also holds trail running events at several other locations. The rules and membership information related to the races are available on the official website. According to previous event announcements, the race headquarters was at the sports field in Nógrád.

name: SALOMON ULTRA TRAIL HUNGARY
location: Lázár cár tér, Szentendre, Pest County, Hungary
distance_verbose: 111 km, 84 km, 54 km, Maraton, 30 km, 22 km
description: The Salomon Ultra-Trail Hungary is Hungary’s premier trail running race, featuring six separate distances and around 1,500 trail runners in total. The race takes place on varied terrain, through dense, dark forests, and challenges participants with demanding elevation gains. The longest distance is 111 km, with 4,200 metres of elevation gain, 9 aid stations, 2 drop bag points, and a 20-hour time limit. The race takes place in Szentendre, with the start and finish at Lázár cár Square. A detailed map and information centre are available for runners and their companions to help ensure the event runs smoothly.
course_highlights: 111 km distance with 4,200 metres of elevation gain
9 aid stations and 2 drop bag points on the longest distance
Dense, dark forests and varied terrain
additional: The maximum race capacity is 1,600 participants, with 300 places available in the longest distance. The race’s Google map includes the aid stations, start and finish locations, and race centre. There are staffed crossings along the course where companions are not allowed to cheer. The Dömös and Pap-rét aid stations are inaccessible by car and require a 30-minute walk.

name: 95. COLOPLAST Tatai Tófutás
distance_verbose: Maraton, Félmaraton, 14 km, 7 km, 3.5 km, 2 km, 0.5 km
description: The COLOPLAST Tata Lake Run is a traditional amateur running race held twice a year in the city of Tata, around Öreg-tó (Old Lake). The race gives amateur running enthusiasts the opportunity to test their strength in a beautiful natural setting along the Tata lakeshore. It is organized by the Tata Mass Sports and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association, which is active in several sports and offers orienteering and other sporting events alongside running races.
course_highlights: The race takes place around Öreg-tó in a picturesque lakeside setting
The running course crosses varied terrain, making it ideal for amateur runners
The event is held twice a year and attracts a large number of participants
additional: The race is organized by the Tata Mass Sports and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association, which has several sections. Alongside running, orienteering, archery, and other sports are also part of the association's activities.

name: COLOPLAST TATA TÓ FUTÁS
distance_verbose: Maraton, Félmaraton, 14 km, 10 km, 7 km, 5 km, 4 km, 3.5 km, 2.5 km, 1.7 km, 0.8 km, 0.3 km
description: The COLOPLAST Tata Lake Run is a traditional amateur running race held twice a year in the city of Tata, around Lake Öreg. It gives amateur running enthusiasts the opportunity to test their strength on varied terrain in a beautiful natural setting. The event is organized by the Tata Mass Sports and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association, which is active in several sports and also offers orienteering and triathlon events alongside running races. The event takes place near the New Boathouse, an ideal location for running.
course_highlights: Running route around Lake Öreg
Varied terrain in a natural setting
Event organized by the Tata Mass Sports and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association
additional: The race is held twice a year. Several divisions of the Tata Mass Sports and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association are active in the city, organizing orienteering, triathlon, and archery competitions as well as the running race.

name: BORVIDÉK FÉLMARATON
distance_verbose: 23 km, 17 km, 14 km, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: The Borvidék Half Marathon is a friendly, family-like running event in Szekszárd, offering participants challenges over several distances, including 23 km races for individuals and teams. The course is almost entirely paved, with a few gravel sections, so road-running shoes are recommended. The event’s special features include regularly spaced relay points and refreshment stations, as well as a children’s race that lets the youngest participants share in the running experience. The race starts in the centre of Szekszárd, at Béla király Square, and is a true community event that offers participants gastronomic experiences alongside running.
course_highlights: Almost 100% paved course, with gravel sections totaling a few hundred metres
Refreshment stations approximately every 3.5–4 km, serving water, isotonic drink and solid food
The 23 km distance can be run individually or in a team of 2–3, with designated relay points
additional: A technical T-shirt is included in the race pack for entries submitted by March 10; entries submitted later receive a cotton T-shirt. The 1 km children’s race is open to participants up to 14 years old and starts at 12:30. On-site registration is available in limited numbers, but not for the children’s race. After the race, participants can enjoy the Borvidék After PARTY. The 23 km distance can be completed individually or in a team of two or three. Refreshment stations are spaced approximately 3.5–4 kilometres apart.

name: 29. Kékes Csúcsfutás
description: The Kékes Summit Run is one of Hungary’s most beautiful and iconic running races. Starting in Mátrafüred, the 11.6 km course climbs to Kékestető, Hungary’s highest point. With 671 metres of elevation gain, the race challenges every runner while offering views of the Mátra’s natural beauty. Finishers receive a unique medal, and shuttle buses help participants travel to and from the event on race day. The event has a friendly atmosphere, can be enjoyed alongside thousands of runners, and also supports participants as a charity run.
course_highlights: 11.6 km course with 671 m of elevation gain between Mátrafüred and Kékestető
Beautiful natural surroundings, forest trails and a panoramic route
Run to Kékestető, the highest point in Hungary
additional: On race day, a shuttle bus runs from Budapest to Mátrafüred, providing return transportation for runners and their companions and also serving as a bag-drop facility. The bus departs Budapest at 8:15 and returns from Kékestető at 10:30. Entrants receive a unique finisher’s medal at the finish.

name: KÉKES CSÚCSFUTÁS TRAIL
description: The Kékes Summit Run is an iconic Hungarian running race that starts in Mátrafüred and climbs to Hungary’s highest point, Kékestető. The race offers two distances: the road race is 11.6 km long with 671 metres of elevation gain, while the Kékes Summit Run Trail is 11.3 km and follows forest trails and steep climbs. Runners can take on the courses amid beautiful natural surroundings and the breathtaking panorama of the Mátra, with a unique finisher’s medal awarded to those who complete them. Several thousand runners from towns and cities across the country take part, and the event is also a charity race.
course_highlights: 11.6 km road race with 671 m of elevation gain from Mátrafüred to Kékestető
11.3 km trail race on forest paths and steep climbs
Beautiful natural surroundings and panoramic views in the Mátra
additional: On race day, a shuttle bus runs from Budapest to Mátrafüred, providing runners and their companions with return transport and serving as a cloakroom. The bus departs at 8:15, with gathering at 8:00 at 152–158 Váci út. Runners receive a unique finisher’s medal at the finish.

name: Hegyre Megyek - Badacsonyi Futófesztivál 500m / 4 km / 8 km / 11 km / 21 km
LÉLEKFUTÁS ÉS PIKNIK
description: The Soul Run and Picnic is a welcoming community event in Magyarpolány, focused on moving and recharging both body and soul. Participants of all ages take part in the race, and the day is rounded out with delicious food and meditative activities such as walking a labyrinth and a gong sound bath. This event is more than just sport: it is a lively, breathing community celebration held in the embrace of nature. It is organized by the Habitus Foundation and takes place as part of the Polány Pentecost event series.

name: SALGÓTARJÁN – LOSONC MARATONVÁLTÓ
description: The International Novohrad Marathon Relay is a relay race between Salgótarján and Lučenec, covering 42.2 km in six stages for teams of 4–6 runners. The route passes through scenic towns, with runners completing the full distance in relay. The event has a friendly atmosphere, with refreshment stations and goulash awaiting participants at the finish, while cultural activities add to the day. The race takes place, and registration is available online; later, registration is only possible on site if places are still available.

name: SALOMON TWIN PEAKS TRAIL
description: The Salomon Twin Peaks Trail is a 22-kilometer trail race that is part of Salomon Ultra-Trail Hungary. The course runs around Dömös and Szentfa-Kápolna and includes the famous “two peaks,” which present a special challenge for runners. This race offers a unique finish-line experience in Hungary, one that only UTH can provide. It is ideal for those who want to get a taste of the atmosphere and trail-running challenges of Ultra-Trail Hungary.

name: SALOMON VISEGRAD TRAIL
description: The Salomon Visegrád Trail is a 30-kilometer trail race starting at the former Roman watchtower in Visegrád and finishing in downtown Szentendre. Runners cross some of the most beautiful and least accessible parts of the Visegrád Hills, on varied and challenging terrain. The race offers an unforgettable experience for nature lovers and trail-running enthusiasts alike. The event is traditionally of a high standard, with well-organized support provided for participants along the course.

name: SALOMON SZENTENDRE TRAIL
distance_verbose: 100 km, 80 km, 53.5 km, 50 km, Félmaraton, 11 km, 10 km, 6 km, 5.8 km, 5 km, 4 km, 3000 meter, 2.5 km, 1.7 km, 1500 meter, 0.85 km, 0.8 km, 0.3 km
description: The SALOMON SZENTENDRE TRAIL is a 54-kilometer trail running race with 1,800 meters of elevation gain. During the race, you’ll run through awakening Szentendre, cross the Apátkúti Stream twelve times, and reach Visegrád, where the midday bells will greet you. At Kálvária, you can reflect on the meaning of life, then return to Szentendre before 5 p.m., where tourists will applaud you in the Main Square and pedestrian streets before you reach the finish on the Danube Promenade. This race offers a unique experience where nature and the urban environment meet.
course_highlights: 54-kilometer course with 1,800 meters of elevation gain
Cross the Apátkúti Stream twelve times
Hear the midday bells in Visegrád and finish on Szentendre’s Danube Promenade
additional: The race center and expo are located at Ferences Sports Hall, Áprily Lajos tér 3, Szentendre. Bag drop is at the Reformed High School. The race is organized as a green event.

name: SALOMON SZENTLÁSZLÓ TRAIL
description: The Salomon Szentlászló Trail is a special trail-running race in Szentendre that includes some of the steepest climbs in the Visegrád Mountains. The race starts at dawn, and participants run across the misty Sikáros Meadow as the cuckoo welcomes the daybreak. Runners finish before 7 p.m., where tourists applaud in the Main Square and along the pedestrian streets. This running experience takes place in a unique natural setting, offering trail runners a genuine challenge and an unforgettable experience.
course_highlights: Climbing some of the steepest slopes in the Visegrád Mountains
Crossing the misty Sikáros Meadow at dawn
Finishing in Szentendre’s Main Square, where tourists applaud
additional: The race center and expo are located at Áprily Lajos tér 3 in Szentendre, in the Ferenc Sports Hall. Bag storage is in the Reformed Secondary School building. Elite trail runners can enter for free based on their ITRA score; during the registration period, inquiries can be sent to hello@ultratrail.hu. The race offers several distances, including 111K, 84K, 54K, 42K, 30K, 22K, and Kids-Trail.

name: BUFF – GOMU 72H WC
distance_verbose: 100 km, 80 km, 50 km, Félmaraton, 10 km, 5 km
organizer: Central European Ultra Series /CEUS/, Balatonfüredi Atlétikai Club, Balatonfüredi Sport Club, Magyar Ultrafutó Liga /KAHU/, Bakonyország&Balcsipart Egyesület, Balatonfüred Város Önkormányzata
description: The BUFF-CEUS 72H World Cup is an international ultrarunning event held at Füred Camping and Holiday Village in Balatonfüred. The event features races of several durations, including 72, 48, 24, 12 and 6 hours, as part of the Central European Ultra Series. The course is a 898-meter loop with a minimal elevation gain of 1 meter, making it ideal for long-distance runners. Participants can compete individually or in teams, and every participant receives a commemorative medal. The event has a friendly, family-like atmosphere, and a central refreshment table is available at the race center.

name: Vártól Várig 1 / 5 / 12 / 25
description: The Castle to Castle running race offers a range of distances—1, 5, 12, and 25 kilometers—for running enthusiasts. The event takes place near 10 Vár tér in Simontornya, in scenic surroundings. It is organized by the Marathon Mass Sports and Environmental Protection Association, which is committed to sport and environmental protection. Traditionally, the event has a friendly atmosphere and is family-friendly, welcoming participants of all ages.
course_highlights: Distances: 1 km, 5 km, 12 km, and 25 km
Scenic surroundings in the town of Simontornya
Varied terrain that challenges every runner

name: V. Tisza-tavi Sportpiknik, Tömegsport Hétvége
description: The 5th Tisza Lake Sports Picnic and Mass Sports Weekend will take place in Sarud, on the shores of Lake Tisza. This community sports event offers participants the joy of exercise and the chance to enjoy the outdoors. The program includes a variety of sporting events and family activities, offering something for all ages. The beautiful surroundings of Lake Tisza make it an ideal place to relax and enjoy an active break.

name: Hegyen-Völgyön futás
description: Hegyen-Völgyön Running is a trail running race held at Tardos’s picturesque football field. Organized by the Sprint Running Club, the event offers running enthusiasts the chance to enjoy nature and varied terrain. The race aims to promote the joy of sport and exercise, and warmly welcomes everyone who enjoys an active lifestyle. The organizers reserve the right to change the date and program.

name: Törökbálinti Hendikep
description: The Törökbálint Handicap is a local running race in Törökbálint’s Dióskert. Participants can run the handicap course, with an emphasis on exercising together and a friendly, community atmosphere.
course_highlights: The race course runs through Dióskert in Törökbálint.
The handicap course consists of laps.
At the New Year’s Eve half marathon, completing four laps makes up the half-marathon distance.

name: V. Kastélykör Flow 5 / 10 / 20
location: Károlyi-kastély, Gróf Károlyi Ede út 1, Füzérradvány, Hungary
description: The 5th Kastélykör Flow is a varied trail-running race in the scenic surroundings of Füzérradvány, offering challenges over three distances: 5, 10, and 20 kilometers. Runners can enjoy beautiful natural scenery and varied terrain, taking in the atmosphere around the castle and the closeness of nature. The event has a friendly, family-like atmosphere and is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners looking to take part in an enjoyable, well-organized race. The race aims to promote the joy of exercise and a love of nature.
course_highlights: Varied terrain around the castle
A run close to nature in Füzérradvány
Distances for all levels

name: Zsámbékfutás 5 / 10 / 21
description: Zsámbék Run is a scenic running race that passes through the towns of Zsámbék and Tök on paved and gravel roads, including the terrain of Nyakas Hill. The race headquarters are at the market square, where runners start and finish. The course offers varied terrain, with gentle climbs, forest sections, and beautiful views of the surrounding hills. The race aims to give every participant a unique finisher’s medal, with an emphasis on preparation and regular exercise. The event was created to support the local community and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: 21.2 km course through Zsámbék and Tök on paved and gravel surfaces
5 aid stations with water, isotonic drinks, glucose tablets, bananas, and biscuits
Trail-running section on Nyakas Hill, with panoramic views and forest paths
additional: The race has a 3.5-hour time limit, but the organizers will wait for everyone, with race staff following the last runner. The course will be fully closed to traffic during the start period, and spectators can easily reach the section in front of the Municipality. In addition to the aid stations, the course is well marked, and volunteers guide runners along the correct route.

name: SÜLYSÁPI FUTÓNAP
distance_verbose: Félmaraton, 11 km, 3.7 km, 2 km, 1500 meter, 0.3 km

name: MÁTRA 115 COMMUNITY TRAIL
description: The Mátra 115 community-organized endurance hike is an extremely challenging 116 km route with 6,100 m of elevation gain, recommended only for experienced hikers and ultrarunners. The start is at Kisnána Castle, and the finish is at the Darázshegyi Guesthouse in Mátraszentimre. The event is organized by the community, with participants helping to organize it, and advance registration is mandatory. Participants have 31 hours to complete the route. Finishers receive a stone award and a certificate, and a finisher’s T-shirt is available to order.
course_highlights: 116 km route with 6,100 m of positive elevation gain
The route passes Kékestető, Galyatető, Ágasvár and several other Mátra peaks
Varied mountain terrain from Kisnána Castle to Mátraszentimre
additional: GPS tracking is provided for participants. Before the start, a special bus runs from Mátraszentimre to Kisnána, with departures at: Mátraszentimre 5:15, Mátraháza 5:35, Gyöngyös 6:00, Kisnána Castle 6:30. The event is community-organized, participants help run it, and participation is at one’s own risk. The long, strenuous distances are intended for experienced, thoroughly prepared hikers and runners.

name: Ederics VAD szíve - max pulzus 2026
distance_verbose: 30 km, 27 km, 24 km, Félmaraton, 18 km, 15 km, 12 km, 9 km, 6 km, 3000 meter
description: Ederics VAD Szíve - max pulzus is a gathering of nature-loving runners in a beautiful location near Balatonederics. The start and finish are at the Csodabogyós Cave, where participants can enjoy being close to nature and the sense of community. The event is about more than performance: it also celebrates love of nature and the joy of exercising together. It is family-friendly and open to runners of all levels who want to test themselves in a special setting.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Csodabogyós Cave
Nature-oriented running course near Balatonederics
Community running event for nature lovers
additional: The event aims to bring nature-loving runners together and create a shared experience. The venue has unique natural features that make it an ideal place to run. The event is family-friendly, and companions and spectators are welcome.

name: XXIV. Büchl Éjszakai Futóverseny
description: The 24th Büchl Night Run will take place in Győr at Tulipános Primary School. The event offers several distances, including a children’s race, individual 7 km, 14 km and 21 km runs, a three-person half-marathon relay, and 7 km Nordic walking. Participants receive a unique finisher’s medal, chip timing, refreshments and medical support. The courses are well marked and supported by police. Race packs are provided to participants in the longer-distance events. Registration is finalized with advance registration and bank transfer.

name: Büchl Éjszakai Félmaraton
description: The Büchl Night Half Marathon is a traditional night race in Győr, offering running enthusiasts a range of distances, including a children’s race, individual races and relays. The event headquarters are at Tulipános Primary School. Participants can expect a well-organized event with chip timing, aid stations, medical support and police supervision. All entrants receive a unique finisher’s medal, and race packs are provided for the 14 km and 21 km distances. The race aims to offer an enjoyable and safe running experience for all ages.

name: Bükk Hegyi Maraton
description: The Bükk Mountain Marathon–Kisgyörgy Ádám Memorial Race is Hungary’s oldest trail marathon, held in Majális Park, Miskolc. The race offers a range of distances, from the marathon to the minimarathon, so everyone can find the challenge that suits them. Runners compete amid the natural beauty of the picturesque Bükk Mountains, while the race unfolds live at the event center, the “forest stadium.” The event aims to foster friendships through sport, promote a healthy lifestyle, and showcase the natural treasures of the Bükk.

name: Ceglédfürdő Futófesztivál
location: Ceglédi Gyógyfürdő és Szabadidőközpont, Cegléd, Hungary
distance_verbose: 28 km, Félmaraton, 14 km, 7 km, 3.5 km, 2 km
description: The Ceglédfürdő Running Festival is a family-friendly running event held in the enchanting setting of the Ceglédi Thermal Bath and Leisure Centre. From the youngest participants to professional runners, everyone can find a suitable distance, whether it’s a children’s race, a fun walk, a longer distance, or a relay. The event aims to let everyone enjoy running, whether with family or while setting personal records. Traditionally held on the first Saturday in June, the event offers a variety of distances for runners.
course_highlights: Distances from 300 m to 28 km, as well as relays (21 km duo and trio)
The event takes place at the Ceglédi Thermal Bath and Leisure Centre
Loop courses of 1–8 laps for the different distances
additional: Bib pickup is on 2027.06.04 from 14:00 to 18:00 at Szabadság Square in Cegléd, and on the morning of 2027.06.05 from 7:00 to 8:30 at the event venue. Changing, shower, and cloakroom facilities are available in the beach changing rooms; portable toilets are beside the start. Entry fees can be paid online by bank card or by bank transfer.

name: Crazy5K
description: CRAZY5K is a unique 5 km obstacle race featuring 10 giant inflatable obstacles. The event is all about having fun rather than performance, making it a great way to enjoy an unforgettable day with friends, family or colleagues. A special family race is also available, designed specifically for families with children under 10, and there are surprises in store for the kids. The event takes place at Budaörs Airport, where parking is available. The entry fee includes a race bib, T-shirt, finisher’s pack, unique medal, refreshments, access to a cloakroom and medical supervision.

name: MOKÜ Run
location: Kismaros Focipálya, Liget utca, Kismaros, Hungary

name: 31. ALDI Női Futógála
description: The 31st ALDI Women’s Running Gala is a special running event held in Budapest’s City Park. Participants can choose from several distances, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them, whether it’s 2.5 km, 5 km, or 10 km. The goal of the running gala is to give participants a break from everyday life, let them enjoy the freedom of movement, and be part of a shared community experience. At the finish line, runners will receive a unique finisher’s medal and a running T-shirt to make the day memorable.

name: Pécs-Orfű-Abaliget Futás 9 / 21
description: The Pécs-Orfű-Abaliget Run is a road race connecting the towns of Pécs, Orfű and Abaliget, with 465 meters of elevation gain. The race aims to bring local running communities together and promote running among the hills and lakes. The event traditionally takes place in early June and offers several distances, including a children’s race. The organizers warmly welcome runners to enjoy nature and the sense of community together.

name: PÉCS -> ORFŰ -> ABALIGET FÉLMARATON
description: The Pécs-Orfű-Abaliget Run is a road half marathon connecting the towns of Pécs, Orfű and Abaliget, with 465 meters of elevation gain. The race aims to bring local running communities together and promote running among the hills and lakes. The event is traditionally held in early June and also offers family-friendly activities, such as a children’s race. With support from local communities and the university, the organizers welcome runners to enjoy nature and sport together.

name: Brutálfutás 15.0
description: Brutálfutás 15.0 is a fun obstacle race in Nyáregyháza, where participants can take on a mix of a military training course and obstacle race over distances of 2, 3 or 7 kilometres. The event is not about performance, but about good vibes and unforgettable experiences, with mud and water guaranteed. Runners can look forward to a unique finisher’s medal and plenty of mud, and can also enter as charity runners. The event attracts participants from hundreds of towns and villages across the country and has a truly fun, family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Bábolna Bio Sunset Run
location: Bábolna Strand- és Termálfürdő, Bábolna, Hungary

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ovis futam -> ingyenes, de regisztrációhoz kötött

description: The Bábolna Bio Sunset Run is an atmospheric race starting at sunset on June 12, 2027, in the center of Bábolna, in front of the Bábolna Beach and Thermal Bath. The course passes the riding arena and the famous Bábolna Arboretum and Animal Park, allowing runners to enjoy the race in a unique natural setting. Participants can choose from three distances, and the half marathon can also be run as a relay. The race is distinguished by its evening start, special ambient lighting, and BioTechUSA refreshments at the aid stations. Every runner who finishes within the time limit receives a custom finisher’s medal, and the evening can be rounded off at the Thermal Bath.
course_highlights: The course passes the riding arena and the Bábolna Arboretum and Animal Park
A sunset start with special ambient lighting
One lap is 5.25 km, two laps are 10.5 km, and the half marathon is four laps
additional: Participants receive a MIZUNO event T-shirt as part of the premium race pack. Full BioTechUSA refreshments will be available at the aid stations. The race office is located at Tüzér utca 9–11 in Budapest, where in-person registration is also possible. At the finish, runners will be welcomed at the Athletes Garden and receive their finisher’s medal; the evening can be rounded off at the Thermal Bath.

name: Edelényi Kastélysziget Esti Körök 3 / 7 / 14 / 21
location: Edelény, L'Huillier-Coburg kastély, Borsodi út 7, 3780 Magyarország
description: Edelényi Kastélysziget Esti Körök is an atmospheric running race held around the L'Huillier-Coburg Castle. The race offers several distances, so every runner can find a challenge that suits them. The event is an ideal choice for those who enjoy the special atmosphere of the castle park and the experience of running in the evening. The organizers welcome participants with professional timing and a convenient registration platform.

name: Kecskeméti Sport Fesztivál
description: The Kecskemét Sports Festival is a traditional community sporting event in Kecskemét, near Benkó Hill. The event offers a variety of running races and hikes, including ultrarunning and shorter distances. Runners can enjoy being close to nature, pleasant weather, and a friendly atmosphere while taking part in sport with the support of the local community. The festival aims to promote sport and recreational activities among the region’s residents.
course_highlights: The scenic natural surroundings of Benkó Zoltán Park and the area around it
A variety of distances, from 300 meters to as much as 68 kilometers
Ultrarunning and classic hill running around Benkó Hill
additional: The races offer several distances and categories, and ultrarunners can complete laps for up to 6 hours. Charity initiatives are also held in connection with the events, such as support for the Trizoli Jótifuti Association. Runners receive a package at the finish, which includes pastries from a local bakery. Local sponsors and civil organizations help create the events’ friendly atmosphere.

name: UTBT (Ultra Tokaj-Bodrogkeresztúr-Tarcal)
description: Ultra Tokaj - Bodrogkeresztúr - Tarcal is a 63 km running race that winds through the picturesque landscapes of Tokaj-Hegyalja, among vineyards and hills. The event offers three different distances, giving both beginner and experienced runners the chance to find a suitable challenge. It is more than just a race: it is a special experience in one of Hungary’s most beautiful wine regions. All starts are mass starts, and runners can enter individually or as part of a team.
course_highlights: A 63 km distance along the legendary routes of Tokaj-Hegyalja
A scenic course among vineyards and hills
The route is provided as a track, with signs and road markings to help runners follow it
additional: Runners can compete individually or in teams of 2, 3, or 4. All starts are mass starts; team start times will be published by June 5 at the latest. Refreshments will be available along the route and at the finish. Participants will also receive a downloadable electronic certificate and race photos. Cutoff times: Ultra 8 hours, Marathon 6 hours, Half Marathon 3 hours. Participants under 18 must submit a parental consent form.

name: BRUTÁLFUTÁS
description: Brutálfutás is a fun obstacle race in Nyáregyháza, where participants can tackle 2, 3 or 7-kilometre distances through mud and a variety of obstacles. The atmosphere is lively and cheerful, with the emphasis on the experience rather than performance. The event takes place on a motocross track, combining elements of a military training course and an obstacle race for an unforgettable adventure. Every participant can expect a unique finisher’s medal and plenty of mud. The event is organised by the Budapest Sport Office (BSI), and thousands of runners take part, coming from towns and villages across the country.
course_highlights: A mix of military training course and obstacle-race elements
Obstacles tackled in mud and water
Varied terrain at the Nyáregyháza motocross track
additional: There are several start times for both distances: the short-distance starts run from 9:30 to 11:00, and the long-distance starts from 12:00 to 15:30. Registration is online only, with payment by bank card or SZÉP card. Every participant receives a unique pig-themed finisher’s medal. The venue is easy to reach from the M5 motorway; the motocross track is at kilometre 9 of Route 405.

name: X. Sopron Trail 5 / 10 / 25
organizer: Sopron Város Polgármesteri Hivatal Sportfelügyeleti Csoportja, SMAFC Tájfutó Szakosztálya, SMAFC Tájfutó Sportjáért Alapítvány, Sopron-Trail
description: The race aims to promote trail running and showcase the wild, scenic areas of the Sopron Hills. Participants can choose from several distances, including 5.9 km, 10.7 km and 25.9 km; one of the events is also part of the Alpokalja Trail King running series. The race offers a special extra challenge on a timed uphill section, where the fastest male and female runners receive a special prize. The race headquarters are at the Brennbergbánya Cultural Center, which has restrooms and showers.

name: CROSSKOVÁCSI Dockyard Terepfutó verseny
description: The Crosskovácsi Dockyard Trail Running Race is a varied trail running event in the scenic surroundings of Nagykovácsi, in the park of Teleki-Tisza Castle. The race offers challenges over several distances, each of which begins with a 1 km opening loop inside the castle park. Participants completing the Mountain Half Marathon receive a finisher’s medal, and several aid stations are available to runners during the race. The event uses electronic timing, and the organizers place particular emphasis on participant safety, providing medical care.
course_highlights: An opening loop inside the castle park on every distance (1 km)
Two aid stations on the course, plus refreshments at the finish
Three aid stations and a finisher’s medal for the Mountain Half Marathon
additional: Bib pickup and on-site registration are available on June 13, 2027, from 7:45 to 9:00. Participants in the Mountain Half Marathon should bring their own "soft-cup" to the aid stations. The race’s rescue system has off-road vehicles and medical personnel available. The entry fee can be transferred to an account held at Erste Bank.

name: SRI CHINMOY FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
location: Széchenyi István University Hegedűs Gyula Dormitory playground, Győr, Hungary
description: The Sri Chinmoy Running Festival is a running race in Győr offering a variety of distances, giving every runner the opportunity to find a challenge that suits them. Participants can enter distances from 5 km up to ultramarathon distances, individually or as part of a team. The event aims to help participants surpass themselves in a friendly and supportive environment. The venue is the courtyard of the Hegedűs Gyula Dormitory at Széchenyi István University, which provides an ideal setting for running.
course_highlights: Distances from 5 km to 50 km in individual and team categories
The Püspökerdő area of Győr and the surroundings of the university dormitory
Varied terrain and the opportunity to complete a half marathon, marathon, or ultramarathon
additional: Individual and team entries are both possible. The event traditionally starts at 8 a.m. Runners can choose from several distances, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them. In previous years, the start and finish area was at the playground behind the Hegedűs Gyula Dormitory at Széchenyi István University.

name: I. Szentivánéji Futótűz 5 / 10 / 21
description: The 1st St. John’s Eve Runaway is a night running festival in the Tóparti Park in Balatonszárszó, held on St. John’s Eve, the shortest night of the year. Participants can choose from several distances, including a half marathon and shorter festival races, as well as children’s races. The event aims to kick off summer on Lake Balaton with an atmospheric, community-focused sporting event that is family-friendly and open to all ages. It is organized by RUNTIME Balaton, which also runs several other sporting events around Lake Balaton. The entry fee includes participation and refreshments, and participants can also purchase a short-sleeved technical T-shirt.
course_highlights: Night running festival in Tóparti Park, Balatonszárszó
5.25 km loops, a half marathon and shorter festival races
Children’s races of 400 m and 1,000 m on the streets along Lake Balaton
additional: Relay handovers take place at the exchange point set up at the finish arch, by passing on the chip-enabled race bib; using a race bib belt is recommended. The entry fee can be paid online by bank card, bank transfer or KH SZÉP Card. The race center opens at 18:30, and on-site registration closes 10 minutes before the start. Residents of Balatonszárszó receive a 30% discount on the entry fee. The event is part of the Ötpróba program, where participants can earn points.

name: SZENT LÁSZLÓ TEREPFUTÁS
description: The Saint Ladislaus trail run is a traditional trail-running race held near Baj, in the Gerecse Mountains, in honor of the patron saint of the infantry and riflemen. The race has been organized by the Tata Mass Sports and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association since 2010, giving runners the chance to test themselves on varied terrain close to nature. The event has a friendly, family atmosphere, and the terrain makes it a genuine challenge for participants. Combining a love of sport and nature, it offers an enjoyable experience for every runner.
course_highlights: Natural terrain in the Gerecse Mountains
Varied landscapes and forest trails
A race held in honor of the patron saint of the infantry and riflemen
additional: The race is organized by the Tata Mass Sports and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association, which has several sections, including athletics and triathlon, orienteering, hiking, and sport shooting. The race traditionally takes place in June, and a hiking challenge is held alongside the trail run. The race has been canceled only once in its history, in 2013, due to flooding.

name: BALATON BAJNOKSÁG
distance_verbose: 100 km, 50 km, 24 km, 12 km, 6 km, 5 km

name: COLUMBIA SUNSET TRAIL
description: The Columbia Sunset Trail is an exciting trail-running race held at sunset on Naszály Mountain, organized by the Trailrun.hu team. The race offers challenges over various distances in beautiful natural surroundings, with plentiful aid stations and a unique wooden finisher’s medal for every participant. The top male and female runners are also awarded prizes. The event has a friendly, welcoming atmosphere, and the organizers provide convenient changing facilities and baggage storage.
course_highlights: A sunset run on Naszály Mountain
Plentiful refreshments at the aid stations and finish
A unique wooden finisher’s medal at every distance
additional: Free, cool photos are available the day after the race. Separate medals are awarded in each distance to the first three women and men to finish. Changing rooms and baggage storage are available at the base. Mandatory equipment: a working, fully charged headlamp and mobile phone, as well as a hydration pack, flask or cup, since there will be no disposable cups at the aid stations or finish. An ID card or a legible copy is required. The race includes plentiful refreshments at the aid stations and finish, a unique wooden finisher’s medal, changing rooms and baggage storage. Mandatory equipment includes a headlamp, a charged mobile phone, a hydration pack or flask, a cup, and an identity document.

name: 32. DECATHLON Futóest
description: The 32nd Decathlon Night Run is a special nighttime race in the heart of Budapest, around the illuminated Heroes’ Square and along Andrássy Avenue. Runners can test themselves over quarter-marathon and half-marathon distances, as well as in pairs and trios, while enjoying the city’s magical nighttime atmosphere. Thousands of runners from towns and cities across the country take part, and every participant receives a unique finisher’s medal and a finisher’s pack. The race starts at 21:00, giving runners the chance to experience running among the city lights.

name: SZUFLA VÉGTELEN
distance_verbose: 24 km, Félmaraton, 18 km, 15 km, 12 km, 9 km

name: KIPRUN FUTÓEST
description: The KIPRUN RUNNING NIGHT is a special night race in the heart of Budapest, around the illuminated Heroes’ Square and along Andrássy Avenue. Participants can test their strength in the quarter marathon, half marathon, pairs and trio events while enjoying the city’s evening lights and historic surroundings. The race has a unique atmosphere where sport and culture come together, and every runner receives a unique finisher’s medal. The event is organized by the Budapest Sport Office (BSI) and attracts thousands of runners from towns and cities across the country.
course_highlights: Run around Budapest’s iconic Heroes’ Square and along Andrássy Avenue
A night race through the illuminated city
Historic statues and atmospheric summer evenings
additional: Runners can choose from several distances: Half Marathon (21.1 km), Quarter Marathon (10.5 km), Half Marathon Pair (2 × 10.5 km), Half Marathon Trio (3 runners; legs: 7.3 + 7.6 + 6.2 km), and 5 km. There is also a warm-up before the start, from 20:20 to 20:30. Registration is exclusively online at nevezes.futanet.hu, with payment by bank card or SZÉP card. A limited-edition technical running shirt is also available for the race.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap is an exciting running race held in Dióskert, Törökbálint. It offers runners a challenge over a range of distances and welcomes participants in a friendly, community-oriented atmosphere. The event aims to promote sport and an active lifestyle while allowing runners to enjoy being close to nature.
course_highlights: A running course close to nature in Dióskert
Distances for all age groups
A friendly, community-oriented atmosphere

name: Holló a Kövön, Várfutás - Palóc TM Kupa
Rácalmás Szigetfutás
description: The Rácalmás Island Run is a family-friendly trail-running event held amid the scenic surroundings of Rácalmás, on the protected Nagy Island and along the banks of the Danube. The varied terrain includes shady forest trails, farmland sections, riverside routes and paved stretches, with minimal elevation gain. The event offers distances for all ages and fitness levels, so beginners and professionals, runners, walkers and cyclists can all find an option that suits them. The race hub is the historic Jankovich Mansion, an ideal venue for the start and finish as well as the accompanying activities.
course_highlights: Varied terrain on the protected Nagy Island
Run along the Danube and on shady forest trails
Minimal elevation gain and easily manageable courses
additional: Refreshment stations are available every 3–4 km, with unlimited refreshments and isotonic drinks. There is also a spritzer station in the forest for adults. The event offers free bag storage and valuables storage. A professional emcee hosts the event throughout the day, and a raffle adds to the programme. Timing is done using disposable HuTag chips. The event is part of the Ötpróba programme, where participants can earn points. Food and drink vendors and a sports playground await families at the event hub.

name: 10. Ócsai Pincesorfutás Radics József emlékére 4 / 12 / 24
description: The Ócsa Wine Cellar Row Run in memory of József Radics is a community trail-running event that passes by the sights of the town of Ócsa. The race covers a 10.5 km distance, which can be repeated for the longer distances, with 21 km and 42 km also available.
