The run uses individual chip timing, and its aim is to bring sport and community together in honor of József Radics. The start and finish are in front of the Egressy Gábor Leisure Center, and the course includes a varied mix of paved and dirt routes.

name: UTT - ULTRA TISZA TÓ
distance_verbose: 130 km, 65 km, Maraton, 28 km, Félmaraton, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km

name: TRAIL RELAY BANSKÁ ŠTIAVNICA – VISEGRÁD
description: TRAIL RELAY BANSKÁ ŠTIAVNICA - VISEGRÁD is a 220 km trail relay race connecting the historic towns of Banská Štiavnica and Visegrád. The race consists of 18 stages that run through the Štiavnica Mountains and the Danube-Ipoly National Park, offering a wealth of natural and cultural attractions. Runners can compete in teams of various sizes or in individual categories, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them. The race aims to connect the two royal towns and showcase the region’s natural and historical heritage.

name: UTT – ULTRA TISZA TÓ
distance_verbose: 130 km, 65 km, Maraton, 28 km, Félmaraton, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km

name: TOKAJ NIGHT RUN
distance_verbose: 220 km, 130 km, 65 km, Maraton, 28 km, Félmaraton, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km
description: The DRK Tokaj Night Run is one of the summer’s most popular running events in Tokaj and the surrounding area, organized by the Tetterő Association. The running festival attracts nearly a thousand participants and is also attended by well-known artists and public figures, making it a community experience as well as a sporting one. The event aims to appeal to families, recreational runners, and running communities alongside competitive runners, with an emphasis on relaxation and shared experiences as well as running. The event takes place at the Tokaj Festival Catlan, which gives it a distinctive atmosphere.
course_highlights: A night run in the scenic surroundings of Tokaj
A community-focused, family-friendly running festival
Participation by well-known artists and public figures
additional: The race is organized by the Tetterő Association, which runs recreational programs and high-quality running races across the country. Its events aim to promote running for all ages and ability levels, with a particular focus on community experiences and relaxation alongside sport.

name: VI. Tapolca Rockwool Trail 8 /  14 km / 22 / 33 / 45
description: The 6th Tapolca Rockwool Trail is a scenic running race through the beautiful landscapes of the Balaton Uplands, around Tapolca-Diszel. The route is 80% dirt roads, cart tracks and trails, offering runners varied terrain and unrivalled panoramic views. There are five distances to choose from, and those up to 22 km can also be completed as hikes. Participants can look forward to unique finisher medals, refreshment stations and a hot meal, while the organisers strive to make the event environmentally friendly.

name: TELIHOLDFUTAM
description: The Full Moon Run is a night race in Esztergom, following a scenic route through Castle Hill, the Water Town and the riverside cycling path along the Danube. The race offers challenges over three distances: 4 km, 10 km and 15 km. The varied course includes cobbled and unlit sections. The event is organized by the Esztergom Futóművek Amateur Sports Association, and runners are required to wear a headlamp. The race is part of the Ötpróba program, allowing participants to collect points.
course_highlights: Route through Castle Hill, the Water Town and the riverside cycling path along the Danube
Cobbled and unlit sections
Night race with mandatory headlamp use
additional: The race has participant limits: 200 runners for the 4 km and 10 km distances, and 100 runners for the 15 km distance. Registration is available online and in person on race day, subject to remaining places. The race is part of the Ötpróba program, where participants can collect points by completing the distances. A headlamp or other lighting device is mandatory for registration.

name: IX. Holdfény Éjszakai Félmaraton és Családi Sportnap
description: The IX. Moonlight Night Half Marathon and Family Sports Day is a charity running race in Erzsébet Liget, Szeged. The event includes a night half marathon and family sports activities, supported by more than 1,100 participants. It is a lively community event focused on bringing sport and charity together.
course_highlights: Night half marathon in Erzsébet Liget, Szeged
The race is accompanied by a family sports day
Charity event with more than 1,100 participants
additional: Race results are available on the Facebook page. The event is community-focused and charitable, with family activities.

name: HAAS MARATON VÁLTÓ
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: The HAAS Marathon Relay is a traditional relay race organized by the Tata Mass Sports and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association. The event combines the excitement of relay running with the beauty of nature, as participants test their strength on varied terrain around Tata. It has a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere and offers an enjoyable program for spectators as well as runners. Open to sports enthusiasts and amateur runners alike, the race is an important event in local sporting life.

name: VII. Csillagok útján… éjszakai futás
description: The 7th Stars Along the Way… Night Run is a special summer running experience on the southern shore of Lake Balaton, at Platán Beach in Balatonboglár. At the event’s new venue, runners can look forward to a wide start/finish corridor and a fully paved route with street lighting along its entire length. Runners can choose from distances of 3.5, 7, and 10.5 kilometres, and walking is also an option at sunset by Lake Balaton. The event is family-friendly, with a 500-metre distance for children, and every participant receives a unique finisher’s medal.
course_highlights: The entire route is paved and lit by street lights
Set in the beautiful lakeside surroundings of Platán Beach in Balatonboglár
A 3.5 km loop; longer distances cover multiple laps
additional: The race centre opens at 09:00, and race-number collection is available. A group warm-up led by professionals and accompanied by music takes place before the start of each distance. The race centre has a stage, photo wall, race-number collection and registration tent, baggage storage, and exhibitors’ stands. Toilets and a row of food stalls are 50 metres from the race centre. Refreshments are available at the end of every lap. The children’s race starts at 20:45, and the adult distances start at 21:30. Race-pack collection closes 15 minutes before each start.

name: DRÁVA FÉLMARATON
description: The Dráva Half Marathon is a traditional 21-kilometer race between Barcs and Heresznye, being held for the fifth time. Runners from several counties take part, with men and women competing in separate categories. The course is varied, and record times have been set in previous years, reflecting the race’s competitive nature and popularity. The event is organized by the local Dráva Running Club and the Heresznye Municipality, creating a friendly and competitive atmosphere for participants.

name: KÖCSI-TÓ FUTÓVERSENY
description: The Köcsi Lake running race is a traditional event with a friendly, family atmosphere, held near Balatonalmádi-Káptalanfüred, around the scenic Köcsi Lake. Everyone who wants to run or walk is warmly welcome to enjoy the natural surroundings and the community sporting experience. The event is organized by the Marathon Mass Sport and Environmental Protection Association, which is dedicated to sport and environmental protection. The race offers several distances, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them.

name: LÁZBÉRCI SRI CHINMOY MARATON
description: The Lázbérc Sri Chinmoy Marathon is a nationally organized running event in Hungary, held in the spirit of peace philosopher Sri Chinmoy. The race traditionally offers the experience of running close to nature and provides participants with a unique opportunity to experience physical and spiritual harmony. Runners can test their strength and endurance on varied terrain in a picturesque setting. The event has a friendly, welcoming atmosphere, and all running enthusiasts are warmly welcome.

name: FUTABUDA a Dunakanyarban
description: FUTABUDA in the Danube Bend is a self-funded, nonprofit running race held at 10:00 in Dunabogdány. The race offers two distances: 6.1 km with 205 metres of elevation gain and 14 km with 356 metres of elevation gain. Runners receive a unique metal finisher’s medal, and prizes are awarded to the top finishers by age group and overall. The race is part of the Ötpróba series but is independent of it, and entries can also be modified on site. Places are limited to a maximum of 200 participants.

name: GAJA-VÖLGY TRAIL
description: Gaja Valley Trail is a nature-focused trail running event held around Károlyi Castle in Fehérvárcsurgó. The race runs through the scenic landscapes of Gaja Valley and the Bakonyalja region, where participants can enjoy varied forest trails and beautiful views. The event is organized by the Gaja Valley Association, which offers hikes and sports activities for nature lovers throughout the year. The race is an ideal choice for anyone looking to spend a healthy, active day outdoors while exploring the area’s natural attractions.
course_highlights: Varied forest terrain in Gaja Valley
Beautiful viewpoints and natural attractions
The surroundings of Károlyi Castle and the natural landscape of the Bakonyalja region
additional: The Gaja Valley Association organizes walking and cycling tours, endurance hikes, and guided hikes throughout the year. The guides know the area well and help ensure safe, nature-friendly hiking. You can hear about events through the newsletter, and share your hiking experiences in the Facebook group.

name: GULYATERELŐ FUTÓVERSENY
location: Tápiógyörgye Falumúzeum, Béke utca 2, Tápiógyörgye, Hungary

name: MONORERDEI FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
description: The Monorierdő Running Festival is a friendly, family-oriented running event held every year in Makkos Park, Monorierdő. Runners can choose from several distances, and the course starts and finishes in Makkos Park. A special feature of the event is a live-music aid station, where the band "The Little Pea" energizes runners twice. The event aims to promote the joy of sport and exercise, and everyone is warmly welcome to join the running community.

name: CSERNYE TRAIL
description: Csernye Trail is a trail running race taking place for the sixth time in 2026 in Bakonycsernye. Starting from the start area next to the sports field, runners can choose from various distances that lead across varied terrain, through forests and over hills. The organizers promise excellent event management and an enjoyable running experience, while participants can admire the natural beauty of the Bakony. The race is family-friendly and recommended for both beginners and experienced runners.

name: ORFŰI TÓ – SHOW FUTÁS
description: The Orfű Lake-Show Run is the traditional running race of the Melitta Leisure Sports Association, held around the large car park by Lake Orfű and its beach. During the race, participants must run one or two laps around Lake Pécs on the road, clockwise, not along the promenade. The race is a family-friendly event, and everyone participates at their own risk. Both professionals and amateurs are welcome. The event is held with the support of Barta Textilház and offers valuable prizes to runners, not only based on their finishing times.

name: TATAI MINIMARATON ÉS FÉLMARATON - Tata, Váralja út 13,5-21km. eredmények
KERESZTÚRI ÖNTÚLSZÁRNYALÁS FESZTIVÁL
description: The Keresztúri Self-Transcendence Running Festival is a friendly, family-oriented race that combines closeness to nature with the spirit of self-transcendence. The race takes place in the Keresztúri Forest near Budapest and offers challenges over several distances, including 5.2 km, 10.5 km, the half marathon, 31.6 km and the marathon, as well as the special Yes, I can! event. The event is organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, which has supported running enthusiasts since 1977. The race aims to give every participant the chance to experience camaraderie through sport and the joy of surpassing themselves.

name: JAZZFŐVÁROS-FUTÁS
description: The Jazz Capital Run is a traditional running race in Kecskemét, held at the Benkó Zoltán Leisure Centre. The event has a friendly, family atmosphere and attracts running enthusiasts from the surrounding area. It’s an ideal opportunity for recreational sport, a shared community experience, and enjoying the proximity of nature.
course_highlights: The race takes place within the Benkó Zoltán Leisure Centre
The route passes by the natural beauty of Kecskemét and its surroundings
A choice of running distances and recreational running opportunities

name: SZUFLA FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
description: The SZUFLA Running Festival is a friendly, multi-distance running event in Szigethalom, in the picturesque Tököl Forest Park. Runners of all abilities, from beginners to ultrarunners, can find a challenge, with distances ranging from 5 km to 52 km, as well as a relay race for teams. Alongside the running, a range of activities adds to the day, so the whole family can enjoy themselves. The event is traditionally held on the first weekend of August, and participants’ times are recorded using chip timing.
course_highlights: A marked 6.178 km loop course in Tököl Forest Park, with 30 metres of elevation gain
A 52 km relay race for teams of 2–4
Children’s races and a run for people with disabilities on the paved route in front of the race centre
additional: On race day, on-site registration opens at 7:00. Timing uses a chip system, with a 2,000 Ft deposit. The deposit is refunded when the chip is returned, but participants may donate it to support the Day Centre for People with Disabilities. Accompanying participants in any way is prohibited. Aid stations are located every 3 km and offer an expanded selection. The event closes at 15:00, which is also the time limit. Free activities for children are available throughout the day (face painting, glitter tattoos, a creative corner, and a bouncy castle). Meal tickets can be purchased for paprikash potatoes and pancakes.

name: RossbRUNn Trail
location: Lókút Sportközpont, Bem utca, Lókút, Hungary
distance_verbose: 56 km, Maraton, 28 km, 14 km, 7 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km

name: SÁRKÁNYFUTÁS
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: The Dragon Run is an exciting running race organized by the Tata Mass Sports and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association. The event is a trail run on a varied and challenging course that combines the experience of being close to nature with the enjoyment of sport. It has a friendly atmosphere, is open to all age groups, and fosters a sense of community among runners. The race takes place in Súr, Hungary, and the organizers place great emphasis on smooth event operations and participant satisfaction.

name: KESZTHELYI KILOMÉTEREK
description: Keszthely Kilometers is a traditional running race on the shore of Lake Balaton, held in the rear park of Festetics Palace. Participants can choose from several distances, from 3 km up to the half marathon, and compete individually or in a relay. There are also children’s races for the youngest participants, with different distances for each age group. The event has a friendly, family atmosphere, and the lakeside setting offers runners a special experience.

name: MOVE SZOMBATHELY SUNSET RUN
description: The MOVE Szombathely Sunset Run is a unique evening and night running race in Szombathely’s main square, offering both children and amateur runners the opportunity to take part. The sunset and the atmosphere of the city center give the race its special feel, creating an enjoyable and motivating running experience. The event aims to make running accessible to all age groups while also providing a shared community experience.

name: BUDAI NIGHT TRAIL
location: Telki Sportcsarnok, Kamilla utca 1–3, Telki, Hungary
description: BUDAI NIGHT TRAIL is a night trail-running race in Telki, offering participants a range of distances. The route is clearly marked with ribbons and signs, and runners receive a hand-painted metal finisher’s medal made in Hungary. Refreshments, medical support and other amenities are available along the course, helping participants feel safe and supported. The event is traditionally organized by an experienced team and has a friendly, family-like atmosphere.
course_highlights: 35.5 km distance with 1,114 m of elevation gain
Clearly marked route with ribbons and signs
Hand-painted metal finisher’s medal made in Hungary
additional: Start and finish at the Telki Sports Hall, Kamilla u. 1–3. Race-pack collection times vary by distance. Course refreshments include chocolate, gummy candies, cheese, dried and fresh fruit, isotonic drinks and salt tablets. Medical support, women’s hygiene products, bag storage and shower facilities are provided during the race. At the finish, a hot meal is available (vegan, gluten-free, vegetarian or meat), along with finisher’s beer (alcohol-free and alcohol-free fruit-flavored). Race photos can be downloaded free of charge. Participants must bring their own plate.

name: SUHANJ!6
location: Margitszigeti Atlétikai Centrum, Margaret Island, Budapest, Hungary
description: SUHANJ! 6 is a charity running race that supports people with disabilities. The race lasts 6 hours, during which individuals or teams aim to complete as many laps as possible on Margaret Island’s flat, accessible 3.5 km loop course. The event starts at midnight, and a sunrise is guaranteed. Alongside the race, a handbike race for athletes with disabilities and a night half marathon take place before midnight. The race center is the Margaret Island Athletic Center, where changing rooms, showers, and refreshment stations are available to runners.
course_highlights: A 3.5 km, completely flat, accessible loop course on Margaret Island
2,500 meters of asphalt road along Margaret Island’s central road, plus 400 meters of synthetic track at MAC
Night running, with a midnight start and sunrise on the course
additional: There is no on-site registration, but a limited number of late entries are available as charity runners, with a gold-colored race bib marked CHARITY RUNNER. Teams may have 2–10 members, and runners may change as often as they like, including after each lap. Headlamps/body lights are mandatory until dawn. Race bibs can be collected in person over several days, or by an authorized representative, at SUHANJ! Fitness (District 13, Budapest). The race center has changing rooms, showers, toilets, and a bag-drop facility. Runners are encouraged to use their own cup or bottle at the refreshment stations. After the race, participants can enjoy breakfast and a charity raffle.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap running race starts and finishes in Dióskert, Törökbálint. The course consists of four laps, but participants can complete fewer laps and tailor the distance to their own goals. The race offers a friendly, community-oriented opportunity to run in the surroundings of Dióskert.
course_highlights: A four-lap course, with the option to complete fewer laps.
Start and finish in Dióskert, Törökbálint.
The lap format allows participants to choose their own distance.

name: NYAKVÁGÓ MARATON
distance_verbose: Maraton, 22 km, 14 km, 7 km, 3000 meter, 0.4 km
description: The Nyakvágó Marathon is a challenging trail-running event in Ballószög, offering runners and mountain bikers a choice of distances. The varied routes include agricultural dirt roads, forest sections, and a cinder running track, with particular emphasis on protecting nature. Participants will find several aid stations along the course, and awards are also given by age group. The event is family-friendly and includes a children’s race that promotes a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: Varied terrain: agricultural dirt roads, forest trails, and a cinder running track
Aid stations every 4–5 kilometers with water, fruit, and glucose tablets
Children’s race promoting a healthy lifestyle, with awards
additional: Wearing a helmet is mandatory for the mountain-bike race. Required race equipment includes the mobile phone specified during registration; a water bottle or hydration pack is recommended. Refreshments are provided without cups. T-shirts can be ordered until August 19 and collected on race day. The 400-meter children’s race allows on-site registration and includes awards.

name: UFO ÓCSA FUTÁS
description: The UFÓ Ócsa Run is a popular city running race held in Ócsa, near the Egressy Gábor Leisure Centre. The event offers challenges over several distances, including 10.5 km and 21 km races that pass through the city's landmarks. The race uses unique chip timing, and places are ranked by gun time. With age restrictions and a limited number of participants, the event welcomes runners in a friendly, family atmosphere.

name: EMU 6 DAYS RACE / GOMU 6 DAYS WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP
description: The EMU 6-Day Race, also known as the GOMU 6-Day World Championship, is one of the world’s most prestigious multi-day ultramarathon events, held in Balatonfüred. During the race, participants run for six days, testing their stamina and endurance. The event is traditionally the pinnacle of multi-day ultrarunning, and world records have been set there. Competitors face a unique challenge that tests both their physical and mental strength.

name: SÜMEG TRAIL
description: Sümeg Trail is a traditional running race that has been attracting running enthusiasts to the city of Sümeg for five years. The race offers challenges over four different distances, which participants can complete amid the city’s distinctive and beautiful surroundings. The event also features a range of sports activities and health screenings, so runners and sports enthusiasts alike can enjoy the day. The venue is Kisfaludy Square, and the program includes yoga, meditation, and performances by local dancers, creating a unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: Four distance options: sweet, treat, spicy, and strong challenges
The race takes place on a distinctive and beautiful course through the city
A varied program of sports activities and health screenings on race day
additional: Yoga classes, singing bowl meditation, and performances by local dancers also add to the race-day program. Health screenings (blood pressure, blood sugar, and body weight measurements) are available to participants.

name: XI. Moonlight Run
description: The XI Moonlight Run is an atmospheric running race held in the town of Szob. Participants receive timing, a race bib, and a unique finisher’s medal. Refreshments are provided on the course and at the finish, where traditional bread with lard and onions awaits runners. The event takes place under medical supervision, and the organizers prioritize the experience of taking part.

name: ATOMFUTÁS
description: ATOMfutás is a traditional, family-friendly running race in the city of Paks, offering a variety of distances for participants, from children to those who prefer longer runs. The event takes place next to the ASE Sports Hall. In addition to the races, families can enjoy a range of activities, including bouncy castles, sports games, and food experiences. The event is organized by the Atomerőmű Sports Association, and its honorary patron is Olympic champion Dr. Antal Kovács. Runners can choose from several distances and participate at their own risk.
course_highlights: A variety of distances: 600 m, 2000 m, 3000 m, 7 km, 14 km, 21 km, 30 km
Relay exchange points in the 30 km relay races, with several exchange options
A sweeper bus follows runners at 8 km/h on the longer distances
additional: On race day, in-person registration is also available at the venue. On the longer distances, a sweeper bus follows the field at 8 km/h; runners who cannot keep up must board the bus. Participants in the BrutálATOM race can choose from several start times and distances, including children’s and adults’ categories. The race center is located next to the Paksi ASE Sports Hall, where race bibs can also be collected.

name: MOONLIGHT RUN
description: MOONLIGHT RUN is a special night race held in the town of Szob. The start and finish are at St. Ladislaus Church, and participants receive a unique finisher’s medal. Refreshments and medical supervision are provided during the event, and runners can enjoy traditional bread with lard and onions at the finish. The race is organized by Proathlon Bt., with support from local governments.

name: 36. BorsodChem Bódva-völgyi Maraton
description: The 36th BorsodChem Bódva Valley Marathon is a running event featuring a variety of distances and several individual and relay categories. The event takes place in Edelény, with chip timing ensuring accurate results. After finishing, participants can access a digital certificate and a personalized finish-line video. The organizers use modern technology, including an LED race clock and online results coverage, to support the event.
course_highlights: A variety of distances, from 500 m to the marathon, with individual and relay categories
Chip timing using RFID or HuTag technology
Online results and a personalized finish-line video
additional: On-site registration is also available. Safety pins are provided with race bibs, and participants can choose between a bib-mounted chip and an ankle chip. A commentator supports participants during the event, and online coverage is available on request. Payment is made by card via SimplePay, which requires a user account.

name: BRUTÁLATOM
description: BrutálATOM is a challenging trail running race in the city of Paks, organized by the Atomerőmű Sports Association. The race offers several distances for runners, including children and adults, with varying difficulty levels. It combines sport with a community experience and is supported by the Paks Nuclear Power Plant. The event is family-friendly, and participants compete at their own risk.
course_highlights: BrutálATOM kids: 1.5–2 km, for ages 6–11
BrutálATOM light: 4–4.5 km, for ages 12 and up
BrutálATOM classic: 8–9 km, for ages 16 and up
additional: The race center is next to the Paksi ASE Sports Hall, where race bibs can also be collected. Several warm-up times are scheduled on race day, and the awards ceremony will take place at 18:00. Registration is online, but on-site payment is also possible on race day from 14:00. Wearing a race bib is mandatory, and participants compete at their own risk.

name: SZŐLŐSKÖR
distance_verbose: 50 km, 36 km, 18 km, 9 km, 4.5 km, 1.2 km

name: III. Pannonhalma Decem Futás 5 / 10
description: The III Pannonhalma Decem Run is a friendly, community-focused running event offering 5 km and 10 km distances around the Porta Visitor Centre. The event aims to provide enjoyable and motivating exercise for all ages, while giving participants the chance to explore the beautiful Pannonhalma landscape. It has a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere and offers sports enthusiasts an opportunity to meet and run together.
course_highlights: Beautiful Pannonhalma landscape and historic surroundings
5 km and 10 km distances on varied routes
Community-focused and family-friendly atmosphere
additional: Chip timing.

distance_verbose: 35 km, Félmaraton, 10 km, 6 km, 3000 meter, 1.4 km, 0.7 km

The race offers participants the chance to be close to nature and enjoy varied terrain, making it an ideal choice for runners who love the outdoors. The race traditionally takes place in the region and is part of the sports association’s active community life.

description: DOMB42X is a unique running race on Kecskemét’s highest point, Benkó Hill, where participants run multiple laps around the hill to complete distances ranging from the half marathon to the ultramarathon. The race’s distinctive feature is its continuous climbs and descents, which pose a real challenge for runners accustomed to flat terrain. The event is family-friendly: spectators enjoy free entry, and a range of recreational activities is available at the venue. A display shows runners how many laps they have completed, making it easier to keep track on the course. This running event is a vertical revolt against the flatlands, offering a unique experience to every participant.
course_highlights: Benkó Hill, Kecskemét’s highest point, at 49 metres
One lap is approximately 1 km; the marathon distance includes more than 2,000 metres of elevation gain
A display shows the number of completed laps at the end of each lap
additional: The race has minimum age requirements: over 11 for the 3 km distance, over 14 for the 7 km distance, and over 16 for the 14 km distance. There are participant limits for all three distances (3 km: 95 runners, 7 km: 95 runners, 14 km: 40 runners). Participants receive a finisher’s medal, and the top three men and women are awarded. Start times vary by distance: 14 km at 11:50, 7 km at 15:00, and 3 km at 16:20. A time limit is also set for each distance.

name: 6. Liget élményfutás 7 / 3.5
description: The 6th Liget Fun Run is a special running event in Budapest’s City Park, where families and friends can enjoy the pleasures of sport and the excitement of more than 20 obstacles together on the 3.5- and 7-kilometer courses. It’s not about competition, but about the experience, where smiles and shared adventures matter most. Participants will receive a unique finisher’s medal and a finisher’s pack, ensuring an unforgettable day. The event is ideal for both beginners and experienced runners who want to take part in a fun, community-focused experience in the enchanting surroundings of City Park.

name: FESTÉK BÁZIS JÁNOSHÁZAI FÉLMARATON
description: The FESTÉK BÁZIS Jánosháza Half Marathon is a fun, well-organized running event that amateurs and professionals alike can enjoy. The race takes place on safe, traffic-free routes, and every finisher receives a medal and a surprise finisher’s pack. The event also offers accurate timekeeping, refreshments every 5 km, and an online photo gallery. At the end of the race, the organizers treat participants to beef stew prepared on site, ensuring a welcoming community atmosphere after the run.

name: Masterprint Tihany Cross Terepfutás és Nordic Walking 5 / 10 / 20 / 30
description: The Masterprint Tihany Cross trail running and freestyle Nordic walking race takes place on the picturesque Tihany Peninsula, with a range of distances: 5, 10, 20 and 30 km. The course winds through beautiful autumn lavender fields and hilly forest trails marked with red marker tape. The event is family-friendly, with children’s races and a relay race. The race centre is located on the shore of Lake Belső, where the refreshment stations and finish area are well equipped. Runners can also order a professional technical running shirt.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP

The half-marathon distance consists of four laps, but shorter distances are also available. Runners will be welcomed at the finish with apples, hot tea and mulled wine.
course_highlights: A loop course in Dióskert, Törökbálint.
The half-marathon distance is completed by running four laps.
A shorter distance is also available.
additional: Voluntary contributions help cover the costs of the race.

name: ESZTERGOM FÉLMARATON
description: The Esztergom Half Marathon is a friendly race on varied terrain that showcases the historic and natural beauty of the city of Esztergom. The event center is located in Szent István Square, and runners follow a route through Várhegy, Víziváros, and the riverside cycling path. Distances include the half marathon, third marathon, sixth marathon, and a relay, so everyone can find a suitable challenge. The event is family-friendly, with children’s races and gifts for the little ones.
course_highlights: A varied route through Esztergom’s historic districts and along the riverside cycling path
Mixed surfaces: cobblestones and asphalt, with climbs and descents
Relay race in the start/finish area in front of the Basilica
additional: Children’s races are free; advance registration is required by email or at the venue. In the relay, the first runner may also be an individual half-marathon participant. Participant limits apply to the distances. ECO entry without a T-shirt, with an old medal, is available. Cutoff times: first loop 55 minutes, second loop 1 hour 53 minutes, half marathon 2 hours 55 minutes.

name: Wink-Intretech KapuvárRun 2026
description: The Wink-Intretech KapuvárRun 2026 will be held for the fifth time in Kapuvár, in Eszterházi Park. The race takes place on completely flat city streets and attracts more Hungarian and international runners each year. The event aims to share the joy of movement and the sense of community, with a great atmosphere and togetherness at its heart. The experience continues after the finish, with award ceremonies and a large event tent where spectators can comfortably cheer on the runners.

name: BERLIN MARATON
description: The BMW BERLIN-MARATHON is one of the world’s largest and most popular marathon races, held in Berlin. The race is famous for its record-breaking, exceptionally flat course, which passes through the city’s most beautiful landmarks. The event offers a special experience not only for professional runners but also for running enthusiasts, thanks to its diversity and the city’s unique energy. The race is part of the Abbott World Marathon Majors series, and participants can choose from a range of options, including a charity run, inline skating, and the Generali 5K race.

name: SRI CHINMOY FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
description: The Sri Chinmoy Running Festival is a traditional running event in Győr, offering a range of distances for both amateur and professional runners. The event takes place in Püspökerdő, with individual and team events over distances including 5 km, 15 km, half marathon, marathon, and ultramarathon. The event aims to help every participant surpass themselves while enjoying nature and the pleasure of running. It has a friendly, welcoming atmosphere and is open to anyone looking for a challenging yet friendly running event.
course_highlights: A nature-filled running course in Püspökerdő
A range of distances from 5 km to 50 km, in individual and team categories
Challenging terrain suited to marathon and ultramarathon distances
additional: Participants can enter in individual and team categories. The race starts at 8 a.m. Runners can choose from several distances, so everyone can find a suitable challenge. Previous race announcements have included a minimarathon, 15 km, half marathon, marathon and ultradistance events, as well as team races.

Many runners choose the half-marathon distance for their first half marathon, as the course and its spectacular sections make for an unforgettable experience. The event is family-friendly, with a baby run for the youngest participants. Runners in every distance receive a finisher’s medal, refreshments, and a running shirt.

description: The SPAR Budapest Marathon Festival is Hungary’s largest recreational sporting event, a two-day running festival in Budapest. Runners can follow a beautiful and varied route past World Heritage sites, enjoying panoramic views of the city and the atmosphere created by enthusiastic spectators. Participants can choose from several distances, from 5 km to the full marathon, so everyone can find the right challenge. A unique finisher’s medal and running shirt make the day memorable.
course_highlights: A route passing World Heritage sites
Panoramic views of Budapest’s most beautiful areas
Numerous bands and enthusiastic spectators along the course
additional: The races start in several waves, with the marathon starting at 9:00. The event also features numerous accompanying activities, a warm-up, and an awards ceremony. Registration is available online only at nevezes.futanet.hu. Participants at the festival receive a unique finisher’s medal and running shirt.

name: 41. SPAR Budapest Maraton® Fesztivál
description: The SPAR Budapest Marathon® Festival is Hungary’s largest recreational sporting event and a true bucket-list challenge for every runner. The race offers a variety of distances, from the classic marathon to shorter, family-friendly events, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them. Thousands of fellow runners will join participants on the beautiful and varied Budapest course, creating a true celebration of running. The festival lasts two days, with a rich program and shared community experiences.
course_highlights: A beautiful and varied course through Budapest
Thousands of fellow runners celebrating running
A range of distances from 5 km to the classic marathon
additional: The events start at several different times; the full and 2-person marathon start at 9:00. The two-day event takes place on October 10 and 11, with numerous accompanying activities and races over different distances. Registration is online only at nevezes.futanet.hu. Participants can also get a unique medal insert and badges at the festival.

name: VII. Panoráma Trail 45
description: Panoráma Trail is a 45-kilometer trail running race in the Zemplén Mountains, linking the historic castles of Boldogkő, Regéc, and Füzér. The race is not about finishing times, but about the experience and closeness to nature. It takes place in October, in ideal running weather. It can be completed individually or as a relay team of 2–3 runners. All participants receive premium services, including castle entry and refreshments. The event aims to offer runners an unforgettable journey on the boundary between nature and history.
course_highlights: A 45-kilometer course passing three historic castles
Varied, technical terrain through the wild forests of the Zemplén Mountains
Several refreshment and relay exchange points along the course
additional: Race bib collection is available on Friday from 17:00 to 19:00 in Füzér and on Saturday from 7:30 to 8:45 at the race headquarters in Boldogkővár. Individual runners can request bag transport from the start to the finish. The race starts at Boldogkő Castle and finishes in Füzér. Relay team members may run across the finish line together. The race is environmentally conscious, with nature conservation a key priority.

Runners can enjoy the beauty of nature, steep climbs, forests, and panoramic peaks while pushing their own limits. The race is not just a competition, but an experience that connects runners with a love of nature and a sense of community.

A breathtaking panorama from the summit of Írottkő and 780 metres of elevation gain

The local wine region and rolling landscape make the race special, giving runners not only a sporting experience but also the chance to enjoy the scenery.

Participants can choose from several distances, from the mini race to the half marathon, and can compete individually or as part of a team. The race is also a points-collection stop in the Ötpróba program, so participants can earn points and rewards. Team running is a separate category in which teams of three compete, but each team member must complete the distance individually. The event is a friendly community gathering that promotes the joy of running and an active lifestyle.

The races take place around Szigliget Castle, allowing participants to admire beautiful landscapes and historic sights. The event has a friendly, family atmosphere and is organized with the support of the local municipality.

The race takes place in October in Szögliget and offers a true adventure for every runner who loves a challenge.

description: “Run for a Day!” is an ultrarunning event in Kecskemét, held in Benkó Zoltán Park. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and create a shared community sports experience. Runners complete an ultradistance in a single day, while participants can also enjoy a carnival atmosphere and a group jog. The program is family-friendly and welcomes everyone who would like to spend an active day outdoors.
course_highlights: Ultrarunning in Benkó Zoltán Park
Carnival atmosphere and a group jog
Healthy living and a shared community sports experience
additional: The event welcomes participants for a carnival jog and ultrarunning, with family-friendly activities and community events.

name: HALLOWEEN RUN
location: Rottenbiller Park, Budapest X. kerület, Hungary
description: The Halloween Run is a special, exciting running event in Budapest’s 10th District, at Rottenbiller Park and on the grounds of the former Kőbánya Brewery. During the race, participants make their way along a dark, spooky course where monsters, ghosts, and frightening effects put their courage and nerve to the test. There are several distances and categories to choose from, ranging from a short sprint to longer laps of up to 21 km. At the finish, music and celebrations await the brave participants who complete this unique experience.
course_highlights: Route through the former Kőbánya Brewery’s cellar system and the surrounding parks
Dark, spooky scenery and frightening surprises along the course
Several distances, including 21 km, 14 km, and 7 km laps, as well as short sprints
additional: The race center is located in Rottenbiller Park and can be reached by several bus and tram services. On-site registration is available no later than 45 minutes before the race start, provided the participant limits have not been reached during online registration. Tours and sprints start at several times, and individual and relay categories are also available.

name: VASKAPU TRAIL
description: Vaskapu Trail is a trail-running race on the wild trails of Esztergom, offering challenges across three different distances for beginners, intermediate runners, and experienced runners alike. The course runs mainly along trails and marked hiking routes, with minimal sections on public roads, allowing participants to enjoy being close to nature. The event is based at Vaskapu Restaurant and its surroundings, where runners can test themselves amid beautiful panoramas and varied terrain. ITRA points can also be earned at the race, making it especially appealing to trail runners.
course_highlights: Three distances: 8 km, 16 km, and 24 km, with different amounts of elevation gain
Run on trails and marked hiking routes, with minimal sections on public roads
Stunning panoramas around Esztergom and varied terrain
additional: The race offers three distances: Nekem 8 (8 km, 410 m elevation gain), Majális 16 (16 km, 780 m elevation gain), and Hideglelés 24 (23.6 km, 1,100 m elevation gain). The time limits are 1 hour 35 minutes, 3 hours, and 4 hours 30 minutes, respectively. The course features runnable climbs, steep ascents, and varied terrain. Competitors must observe the rules of the road; the organizers accept no responsibility for any accidents.

name: Feldwar Trail 1 / 5 / 10 / 17 / 23
description: Feldwar Trail is a friendly, family-oriented trail running race among the hills of Dunaföldvár, with stunning views and an impressive race headquarters at Ispánház. Runners can choose from several distances, from the children’s races up to 23 km, with women’s and men’s categories awarded separately. The routes run mostly on dirt roads, with very little paved surface, allowing participants to enjoy being close to nature. The race is organized as a green event, so the organizers ask runners to bring a water bottle or their own cup for the aid stations.
course_highlights: Trail routes through the hills of Dunaföldvár
Stunning views of the southern Danube Bend from Kálvária and the ridge along the Danube
Mostly dirt roads, with very little paved surface

The cutoff time is advisory; finishers will receive a medal even if they finish after the cutoff. Distances: 1, 5, 10, 17, and 23 km; aid stations on the different distances; chip timing; option to run the course as an instant challenge; children’s races; individual or group registration; awards by category.
